name: Adam Schiff
subject: Some thoughts on Tax Day earlier this week
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=6283%2E5257348%2EpA8zbh ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek,
another Tax Day has come and gone.

It can be a tough day (I don’t know about you, but I owed a lot), but
paying our taxes is the price of good governance, vital infrastructure,
our safety net, and our national defense.

This Tax Day brought to mind just how stark the difference is between
Steve Garvey and me. For one thing, I pay my taxes. All of them. I don’t
have a fortune in tax liens against me because I don’t pay my bills. Wish
my opponent could say the same.

Tax Day also highlights the differences between Joe Biden and Donald Trump
— and the profound impact this election will have on our economy.

Derek, in
2017, when Republicans controlled Congress, Donald Trump signed a tax scam
into law. Republican senators invited corporate lobbyists into the Senate
to co-author the bill, and it passed in the dead of night, the week before
Christmas. It was a $3.5 trillion giveaway to their megadonors and large
corporations.

That tax law is up for renewal in 2025. Trump and Garvey want to extend it
— and give away another $3.8 trillion to their rich friends.

Meanwhile, Joe Biden has a plan to make the wealthy and corporations pay
their fair share, with a plan that would raise $4.9 trillion in tax
revenue and cut the deficit by $3.2 trillion.

President Biden’s Inflation Reduction Act already instituted a 15%
corporate minimum tax — making corporations pay their fair share after the
Trump tax scam allowed some of them to pay $0 some years in federal taxes.

Now, he’s going a step further with a proposal for a billionaire minimum
income tax of 25% on households with a net worth above $100 million.

No president in the modern history of this country has done more to level
the playing field than Joe Biden. That’s the story we need to tell across
California, and across the country. And I will proudly work alongside
President Biden to pass fair tax laws in the Senate — no corporate
lobbyists invited.

are fighting for the American people. Will you donate

Democrats up and down the ballot so we can build an economy that works for

name: Dr. Kristin Lyerly
subject: I’m an OB/GYN who tried to block Wisconsin’s abortion ban
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
I wanted you to hear it from me personally: I’m officially running to flip Wisconsin’s 8th district blue.
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/66039?t=6&akid=13879%2E878179%2EELMYqI) My name is Dr. Kristin Lyerly –

I am an OB/GYN who worked to care for patients at Planned Parenthood and who has been **personally targeted and attacked by Republicans and anti-abortion extremists for my efforts to REVERSE Wisconsin’s abortion ban.**

I wanted you to be the first person I told: **I’m officially running to flip Wisconsin’s 8th Congressional District blue and be the only pro-choice OB/GYN in Congress.**

[We need a strong showing to launch our campaign: So I’m asking if you’ll become a founding donor to my campaign by splitting a donation between my campaign and the Voter Protection Project before midnight.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/66039?t=7&akid=13879%2E878179%2EELMYqI)

I have seen firsthand the effects of Wisconsin’s abortion ban – which stems from a law passed in 1849 that went into effect after _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned. Most doctors didn’t even know that germs caused diseases back then. It was nearly 70 years before women would even be allowed to cast their first votes.

As a result of this draconian ban, I can no longer treat my patients and pregnant women in Wisconsin under threat of criminal prosecution. Republicans have targeted my medical licenses and personally singled me out in their lawsuits for my work with Planned Parenthood to make me an example of what would happen to others who do the same.

**As a result, I commute regularly to Minnesota and have traveled to Arizona to deliver babies and care for pregnant women.** All across the country, women are traveling across state lines from states like Wisconsin that have stripped them and their families of the best medical options for them and their safety in order to seek reproductive care.

Our healthcare system is in crisis. Nurses and doctors are leaving the state and the profession in droves. Mothers and women are scared and confused. And it doesn’t have to be like this.

**With your help IT WON’T be like this in the future.** We are going to restore reproductive rights here in Wisconsin and all across the country. Which is why I decided it’s time to run for office.

Wisconsin’s 8th Congressional District is an open seat that Democrats were just 3 points shy of carrying in 2018’s Senate election. With your help, we will flip it blue and win a pro-choice majority that will act to codify _Roe v. Wade_ into law.

**So if you’re with me in this fight:** [I’m humbly asking if you will become a founding donor by splitting a donation between my campaign and the Voter Protection Project today.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/66039?t=8&akid=13879%2E878179%2EELMYqI) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Kristin Lyerly and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/66040?t=9&akid=13879%2E878179%2EELMYqI)

subject: Week 15: Legislative Update
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTE BOLICK
body:
| | | [ ](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=371430d71c&e=a7ab36849c)
---
| | Dear Freedom Fighters,

The legislature continues to deal with the aftermath from last week’s Arizona Supreme Court [ruling](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=6a527d227d&e=a7ab36849c) on abortion. It is worth noting, Tuesday also marked the legislature’s official 100thday of this legislative session. It isn’t “business as usual” to have a once-a-week legislative day. The governor has been MIA on the budget and there are no tangible negotiations in sight.

On Tuesday, something happened to me that hasn’t happened in my entire time at the Capitol—a bill of mine was [vetoed](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=37c34162f8&e=a7ab36849c). It was a [bill](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=2e5749cd5e&e=a7ab36849c) that former Senator Kaiser requested I carry since he was no longer there to sponsor it dealing with blockchain.

However, a very important piece of [legislation](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=0244b538c3&e=a7ab36849c) of mine was signed into law that same day helping to prohibit court-ordered family reunification camps if both parents don’t consent. A friend introduced me to Adam, a father, late last year requesting we get together to talk about reunification camps. He spent some time educating me about what they are and the horrors his family experienced. I told the father I would side with protecting our children from these camps and file a bill. You can read more about it [here](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=8c16882e92&e=a7ab36849c) and read Adam’s story. It made front page news this week.

These “camps” are a for-profit scheme where children within broken families are forcibly taken against their will from the parent, they prefer to spend their time and are put through rigorous mental health evaluations and therapies until the children convey a convincing desire to be with the other parent. Many times, the parent the child is choosing to be away from is an abuser, and the trauma associated with being forced back into this environment only furthers the cycle of victimization.

Sadly, on the Senate side nine out of 14 Senate Democrats and nearly all the House Democrats voted NO on protecting our children from this heinous practice. [Listen](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=8c66317957&e=a7ab36849c) to one of the young ladies who came into the legislature to testify on behalf of the success of this bill’s passage.

On Wednesday, the Senate Committee on Finance and Commerce (FICO) approved three commissioners to the Industrial Commission. You can read who was asked to be confirmed [HERE](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=845b6a2e2b&e=a7ab36849c). Their [bios](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=e0d8834658&e=a7ab36849c) are also posted online. And yes, I did get a chance to ask a few questions.

Also, as I mentioned last week, the legislature needs to repeal the vague 1864 territorial law in favor of the 15-week law that was passed in 2022. Of course, I have been attacked from both sides of the issue who are quite passionate about being pro-life and pro-choice, and that is understandable. It is time to modernize Arizona's abortion laws by turning the debate to empowering young women to make it easier to carry their baby to term or give the baby another loving home. The pre-statehood law is vaguely written, so it could potentially allow a rapist to claim custody of a child. As everyone knows, there are _no_ exceptions for rape or incest in the Civil War-era law. Can you imagine a minor child who has been sex-trafficked, or violently gang raped having to share custody with her rapist?

As a state legislator I have an incredible pro-life record. I have worked on protecting all lives, especially the most vulnerable. From the earliest moments of life to protecting women's health by providing safe housing and a nurturing community for homeless pregnant women. In 2022, I supported the 15-week legislation, like the law challenged in _Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization_. The bill includes exceptions for medical emergencies or severe fetal abnormalities.

During the 2021 and 2022 legislative sessions, heartbeat bills were introduced, but conservative-leaning special interest groups killed these bills from moving too far along in the process. You can read them for yourself [HERE](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=303ff763ca&e=a7ab36849c) and [HERE](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=1b1f390836&e=a7ab36849c).

On Thursday, I helped distribute over 100 refurbished laptops donated by AT&T to a Boys and Girls Club in our legislative district to help bridge the digital divide. The Boys and Girls Club affiliated with [Palomino](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=51995ef94e&e=a7ab36849c). Each laptop also comes with a two-year warranty with Compudopt that includes technical support. The main message I shared with these families was to encourage responsible use.

On Friday, it was an honor to host the [Hispanic Liberty Alliance](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=bd1b3dd9ef&e=a7ab36849c) and the [American Federation for Children](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=7123ff1465&e=a7ab36849c) in the Senate. School choice is my passion, and I am thrilled countless other happy warriors have joined the movement to empower families to make the best choices for their kiddos. Educational freedom is our civil rights issue of our day. I am happy to be a part of it! It is such a powerful message to spread.

Now, for the pressing issue before the legislature: where do we go from here to save more babies’ lives? Many people all over our state have contacted me to figure out where Arizona currently stands and what the legislature plans to do to address the recent Arizona Supreme Court ruling _and_ how to beat the radical [Abortion Access Act](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=9323d9bb94&e=a7ab36849c) come November.

Last Tuesday, our state made international news when the Arizona Supreme Court ruled abortions are illegal in nearly all circumstances under a pre-statehood law _except_ when necessary to save the life of the mother. The pre-statehood law could also apply to any person who “provides, supplies, or administers to a pregnant woman, or procures such woman to take medicine, drugs or substance, or uses or employs any instrument or other means whatever, with intent to thereby to procure the miscarriage of such woman, unless it is necessary to save her life.”

Under Arizona’s 2021 and [2022](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=6a1e36a3c1&e=a7ab36849c) laws, women who get an abortion can no longer be prosecuted, and the most recent ruling doesn’t change that. In [2021](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=46ddd205f9&e=a7ab36849c), there was a bill that exempted “a woman from criminal prosecution or civil liability if any abortion was performed on her because of a child’s genetic abnormality.”

There are no criteria in the pre-statehood law on how to best determine how to help medical providers determine when an abortion would be legally allowable. An Arizona [2022](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=d467c3cece&e=a7ab36849c) law at least helped provide more clear definitions. This [same](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=8d516405c8&e=a7ab36849c) law removed language from the territorial law stating, “a pregnant woman on whom an abortion is performed, induced or attempted in violation of section 36-2322 may not be prosecuted for conspiracy to commit any violation of this article.”

In 2022, because of a case filed with Maricopa County Superior Court, it barred enforcing the law for 45 days after the Arizona Supreme Court ruling becomes final. Last week, the Arizona Supreme Court stayed enforcement of the territorial law for 14 days to give the plaintiffs an opportunity to pursue other legal challenges in lower court if they wish, including challenges to the ban’s constitutionality.

In June 2022, the U.S. Supreme Court ruled on _Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization_ , it removed these _Roe_ protections. Alliance Defending Freedom filed a petition to remove the injunction against the ban. It is important to note there is a very good chance the pre-statehood law will likely _never_ take effect due to the many legal challenges that would be filed continuing to litigate through our state’s courts.

Sadly, Arizona currently has both a Democrat governor and Democrat attorney general. Hobbs’ [executive order](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=107a2d0e2a&e=a7ab36849c) last year gave all power to enforce abortion laws to the state’s attorney general. The [AG](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=166559bd79&e=a7ab36849c) said she would not enforce any abortion bans, and many of the state’s county attorneys have said similar things.

We have seen in other states like [Idaho](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=c0694ae5df&e=a7ab36849c) how this conundrum has led to licensed medical doctors fleeing to other states, or simply no longer practicing obstetrics due to their newest law. Arizona would be no different in trying to figure out when a medical emergency is so severe that they can perform an abortion without fearing retribution. The pre-statehood law mandates two to five years in prison for anyone aiding an abortion, _except_ to save the life of the mother. Our state’s rural and tribal areas already lack quality medical care. What does that mean for the future of medical care across Arizona?

The territorial law was put into place in 1864 before Arizona became a state. In 1973, when the U.S. Supreme Court issued its ruling in _Roe v. Wade_ , Arizona’s Court of Appeals issued an injunction against the territorial law. In 1977, the Arizona Legislature re-enacted this territorial legislation. It was signed by then Democrat Governor Raul Castro. The new code had a delayed effective date until October 1, 1978, so that another legislative session could consider the new code and add other changes and amendments as might be needed.

Babbitt became Governor on March 4, 1978, and he signed Chapter 201 on June 9, 1978. No change was made in the abortion law and Gov. Babbitt did not ask for one. One current sitting Democratic State Senator, Lela Alston, who voted for the bill in the 1970s now wants to repeal the old law she initially supported.

As I mentioned in last week’s legislative update, in early March, precinct committeemen asked me to please consider doing something to counter the Abortion Access Act that would be on the November 2024 ballot. It was highly recommended the legislature draft a ballot referral like the 15-week bill signed into law in 2022.

At a time, such as these, many public officials are required to step up and lead. My current action would not have been my first choice, but I don’t see a consensus in our caucus to send a counter referral to the November ballot. Between the House and Senate, I have seen several potential [ideas](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=6253610d48&e=a7ab36849c), but there doesn’t seem to be a consensus to even send one.

It is my hope that the pro-life community will devote its energy and defeat the radical Abortion Access Act in November rather than attacking its steadfast friends who simply disagree with their highly risky all-or-nothing strategy.

Now, is the time for the pro-life community to step up and fight for our cultural values to be more pro-life.

_I side with saving more lives. I will do everything I can to help defeat the radicals’ plan to kill babies on demand up until the moment of birth. I too want to be sure we are saving as many mothers lives as possible. _

It took many years to achieve this success, and the Republicans and Democrats at the time came together and accomplished it, but it didn’t happen overnight.

Come November everything is on the line in Arizona. Will you be a single-issue voter, or will you be someone who sees the “Big Picture” knowing our state is about to turn blue? This past week, Larry Sabato’s Crystal Ball changed Arizona to “[Leans Democrat](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=6afb805b78&e=a7ab36849c)” on its latest Center for Politics map giving the Democrats a +3 advantage.

[Voters](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=c72ad5f9e4&e=a7ab36849c) across Arizona currently see the Abortion Access Act as being viewed as more palatable than the territorial law. Read the latest poll for yourself [HERE](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=3f8bb58baa&e=a7ab36849c).

Arizonans that I have met at their doorsteps are more worried about our inflationary economy’s impact on gas and food prices, the ability to afford housing, and of course, our wide-open border that brings deadly fentanyl into our community.

Please don’t let the Democrats’ _only_ campaign strategy to keep abortion front and center distract us from the real problems at hand. The Democrats don’t have any other issue to run because the economy is not headed in the right direction. And millions of illegals and criminals have flooded our borders making our communities less safe and more vulnerable to rising crime.

We watched what happened in other swing states and even in red states in 2022 when abortion rights advocates enshrined abortion up until the moment of birth into several State Constitutions. I hope Arizona isn’t next!

Take care,

Yesterday, a remarkable weekend session in Congress saw [Democrats and Republicans finding common cause](https://substack.com/redirect/4e0b390e-1cb2-47fe-81d2-8b06e8348745?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as they passed a military spending bill that will lavish over $61 billion on weapons contractors supplying Ukraine, as well as Israel and other allies, such as Taiwan. The House passage of this bill is significant for many reasons.
Not long before, [two recent resignations among House Republicans](https://substack.com/redirect/564a1d8b-3b4a-44e9-ab08-da112e914ce7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) had tipped the House closer to partisan equipoise, at the same time that the far right flank of the GOP mounted [yet another attack on a Republican Speaker of the House](https://substack.com/redirect/85484364-b543-481e-bcbb-9a9ce32ee815?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in retaliation for his cooperation with Democrats.
I [wrote last year](https://substack.com/redirect/a9a6b1bd-825e-4458-bac7-c229b925d6b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that Johnson's ascension to the Speakership would portend only escalating chaos, and also that weapons sales are the one thing that [consistently](https://substack.com/redirect/ea1e8137-bcee-4508-950c-84ec29b764e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) bring together Democrats and Republicans despite their seemingly constant acrimony.
I really do wish I were proven wrong more often.
> _The surveillance law recently extended by Congress and signed into law by Biden was originally passed in the 1970s to prohibit precisely the activities that it has since been amended to allow._
**Washington 's dedication to militarism**
Speaker of the House Mike Johnson received support from both Republicans and Democrats to pass the military spending bill, which over 110 Republicans--a majority of the GOP caucus--opposed. The bipartisan dedication to war and weapons sales that enabled that vote is Washington's most consistent pattern.
_Help inform your friends!_
[ Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=143833200&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQzODMzMjAwLCJpYXQiOjE3MTM3NTE4NTAsImV4cCI6MTcxNjM0Mzg1MCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.u2baz0lCqgwW3FXGn8sZtHFT7z_hp8zGOKk5fPSJtu4)
This disturbing collusion of supposedly opposed political parties not only fleeces the American public and degrades human rights around the world, but also undermines national and global security. The war in Ukraine has been a boondoggle since well before it ever started, prompted by a [2014 coup supported by Washington](https://substack.com/redirect/b86fafd1-adb4-4772-8e3d-19aa06184519?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that put in place a right wing Ukrainian government.
Russia's invasion of Ukraine was far from unprovoked. In fact, it was effectively invited by NATO's attempted eastward [expansion](https://substack.com/redirect/52002815-8904-4abf-a87e-e21b3d4685eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which crucially violates a "[cascade of assurances](https://substack.com/redirect/1a1bde95-fb83-4784-ab7d-57a35da7496b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" made to Russian leaders dating back to 1990.
In that context, continuing to arm Ukraine is more similar to the CIA's [long](https://substack.com/redirect/0d9d714b-4dc9-4213-86fd-6e9483feb321?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and disturbing [pattern](https://substack.com/redirect/b655d5d0-4362-4978-9b60-e19acc9ccf03?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of funding [and](https://substack.com/redirect/d50c60ba-674e-4bbb-b051-40fc3bbde55d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) training right wing terrorists than anything resembling support for a legitimate government defending itself from international aggression. Expanding the time horizon beyond the news cycle reveals that, as has often proven the case, it is Washington initiating aggression in violation of international law.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/38f8ad8f-8107-44a8-881d-d7c7e98f6733?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source: Wikimedia Commons
Nothing about that advances security. Instead, Ukraine and Russia have each [lost roughly half a million lives](https://substack.com/redirect/0ca9156e-5353-4a30-90ea-78dbabd5e747?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), while Washington continues to treat Ukrainians as expendable "[cannon fodder](https://substack.com/redirect/3e3cd45f-39c4-491c-a0f3-49b8e8e2c03d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" in the service of advancing Washington's [geopolitical interests](https://substack.com/redirect/bfedc5d1-5a70-4b78-8fc4-8d28ce0de604?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Of course, Ukrainian leaders have [welcomed](https://substack.com/redirect/e2a4583a-33a1-4466-8c03-0dd70e9ec65d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Washington's support, while [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/e2d6e8fc-282a-4992-b90e-812d7d4616f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of their battlefield progress and prospects have tended to paper over [a more harsh reality](https://substack.com/redirect/0000fc75-4411-4b8c-a5c9-219009f31b2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
### **Militarism undermining the rights of Americans, not just lives abroad**
Beyond the military spending advanced by the House this weekend, the corporate political parties in Washington also recently came together to [extend and expand](https://substack.com/redirect/cb57c5eb-7385-4876-9e4e-6a2cef30f8b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) unconstitutional government spying in spite of bipartisan rhetoric about respecting constitutional rights.
I've dedicated decades of my life to challenging the mass surveillance apparatus, starting years before the Snowden revelations proved to the world that the [longstanding](https://substack.com/redirect/e4f21423-2176-4e7d-b80b-320edc850380?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) concerns of advocates were more well founded than gullible journalists--spoonfed lies by self-serving government sources and tech companies profiting from government contracts--were willing to admit.
The surveillance law recently extended by Congress and signed into law by Biden was originally passed in the 1970s to prohibit precisely the activities that it has since been amended--[first in 2009](https://substack.com/redirect/70056aad-1dac-4d26-afce-8a73ab46b448?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and then [again](https://substack.com/redirect/5cceffd3-d662-4458-ab9c-875bf1d1fa33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the past few weeks--to allow.
Congress passed the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act in 1987 with good reason: a [multiyear congressional investigation in the 1970s](https://substack.com/redirect/39060a8c-7d5b-4c85-a452-fcea9342743a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) discovered wanton lawlessness across agencies including the FBI, CIA, and Defense Department. Yet, in the years since then, particularly in the wake of the 9-11 attacks of 2001, Washington has embraced a vision of authoritarian government omniscience surrounding communication, with devastating consequences for freedom of expression, journalism, and public transparency.
_This newsletter is supported by readers, not advertisers. To stay informed,**sign up for a free subscription**! To support my work, please consider becoming a paid subscriber_.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..sjvk_Lro7Zb6iqG7ipurRT1SX7UmA3rEb0t5owA3zb0?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=143833200)
Ironically, despite Trump taking [public aim](https://substack.com/redirect/1901ea03-e2b4-4fac-8327-e75c0635244e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at the intelligence agencies, many of his supporters in Congress voted to extend and expand Section 702, empowering the very same agencies that he claims are marginalizing Americans.
Ironically, so did many Democrats in Congress, even while [braying](https://substack.com/redirect/693c970b-99e8-4882-a7a7-befb8b858563?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about the threat to democracy that Trump represents should he regain the White House and recognizing [Biden's self-inflicted political wounds](https://substack.com/redirect/e846b0ca-60c2-4949-9c78-d461a83a640d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) stemming from his support for the continuing Israeli genocide in Gaza.
The hypocrisy of these figures--on both sides of the partisan aisle--can not possibly be overstated.
### **Bipartisan attacks on basic constitutional rights**
Despite the opposition to military spending by some Republicans in Congress, it would be a mistake to think that the party meaningfully opposes militarism, or the authoritarianism it invites. In fact, the very same ranks of Republican policymakers have also embraced radical assaults on basic constitutional rights.
And Democrats have joined them.
For instance, Sen. Tom Cotton (R-AR) recently encouraged [vigilante violence](https://substack.com/redirect/3d36175f-3077-4a63-af77-9fffbf2bb593?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) towards protesters, just weeks after former Speaker of the House Nancy Pelosi (D-CA) invited [FBI investigations](https://substack.com/redirect/1a77c66d-d03a-471b-ac7f-f6a1c9cb42ea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of her political critics.
_Paid subscribers can read a further section about how GOP infighting offers theater more compelling than any productions on either Broadway or Hollywood..._

subject: Sunday News Digest: 4/21/2024
body:
Your weekly rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
Heidi Ganahl introduces the Rocky Mountain Voice, a new conservative news media platform for Coloradans to be the VOICE of your VALUES.
| | [ ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
| **April 21, 2024**
# **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST**
### By Heidi Ganahl
---
| Hi friends, In the State Legislature, anti-gun measures are on the rise, buoyed by their majority status. But gun owners are gearing up to challenge every infringement on their rights. Here's a rundown of the anti-2A proposals under consideration (and [here's an update](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) of where these bills stand after the weekend's votes):
* An "Assault Weapons Ban" targeting the majority of commonly used firearms.
* The "Sensitive Spaces" bill, restricting public carry almost entirely statewide.
* Increased requirements for concealed carry permits, moving away from constitutional carry.
* Mandating gun merchants to obtain a costly state permit in addition to federal licenses.
* A proposed 11% excise tax on firearms and ammunition.
* Compulsory liability insurance for law-abiding gun owners.
* Allocation of taxpayer funds to create a "gun police" task force.
* Mandating locked storage for firearms left in vehicles and tracking gun purchases via credit and debit cards.

Support from citizens is crucial, both in the immediate battle and for the long-term defense of Second Amendment rights. If you'd like to get involved, reach out to [Rocky Mountain Gun Owners (RMGO)](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Colorado State Shooting Association (CSSA)](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Also, make sure you [reach out to your legislators](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) ASAP to tell them your opposition! Have a great week, Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
# STATE
[**‘We should cease reintroduction now’: Republican legislators sound off on wolves killing more livestock**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The results of reintroduction of gray wolves into western areas of Colorado is drawing the ire of many Republican members of the State Legislature, several of whom earn a living from livestock.
**[Colorado House advances measures on concealed carry, gun licensing and liability](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) House Democrats voted to pass three gun bills late on Saturday night, including one that would require gun owners to obtain a liability insurance policy for their firearms.
**[Voters may get to decide on cost-saving shortening of Colorado legislative session](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COMPLETE COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Independence Institute President Jon Caldara has become well known for his willingness to take issues directly to the voters, and one topic has catapulted to the top of his “must do” list.
[**Colorado Libertarians call for end to Middle East violence, condemn all sides of conflict**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) War and violence are never the answer to resolving international disputes, a statement from the Colorado Libertarian Party reads. The party has issued a statement condemning escalating conflict in the Middle East and calling for a peaceful resolution between Israel, Hamas and Iran. **[READ MORE STATE NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
# NATIONAL
**[How much do we really know about the composition of the Trump jury?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [POLITICO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The first week of former President Donald Trump’s criminal trial has concluded, and a full jury has been chosen — twelve jurors and six alternates. Beginning next week, they’ll put to the test Trump’s contention that he can’t get a fair trial in liberal Manhattan.
**[New polling finds Biden’s approval rate slumping, disapproval rate growing](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**The State of the Union Address may not have had the result for President Joe Biden that he would have hoped. Emerson polling finds that his job approval rating has continued to slide since the address, and his job disapproval rating has continued to rise.
**[News organizations urge Biden and Trump to commit to presidential debates during the 2024 campaign](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE WASHINGTON TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**Twelve news organizations on Sunday urged presumptive presidential nominees Joe Biden and Donald Trump to agree to debates, saying they were a “rich tradition” that have been part of every general election campaign since 1976. [**READ MORE NATIONAL NEWS**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
# LOCAL
**[Gray wolf from Great Lakes population caught in coyote trap in Elbert County](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE FENCE POST, ELBERT COUNTY](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**A rancher in Elbert County, Colorado, contacted Colorado Parks and Wildlife after discovering a wolf-like animal in a legal coyote trap on April 3 on a ranch in eastern Colorado.
**[FAA, United investigate video showing ‘unauthorized person’ in flight deck during Rockies flight](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER7, DENVER**
**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and United Airlines have launched investigations after a video reportedly showed an “unauthorized person” in the flight deck during a Colorado Rockies flight.
**[12 students and teacher killed at Columbine to be remembered at 25th anniversary vigil](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO SPRINGS GAZETTE, LITTLETON](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**The 12 students and one teacher killed in the Columbine High School shooting will be remembered Friday in a vigil on the eve of the 25th anniversary of the tragedy. **[READ MORE LOCAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
# COMMENTARY
**[Orr, Rolling: Xcel power blackout showcases the high cost of unreliable electricity](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COMPLETE COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
** _Hundreds of thousands of Xcel Energy customers in Colorado recenlty lost power as high winds damaged power lines, and Xcel preemptively shut off the power to 55,000 customers to mitigate the risk of wildfires. Among the customers who lost power were homeowners and small businesses who received little to no warning._
**[Sloan: Mr. President, “don’t” is not a foreign policy](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
** _After receiving intelligence reports that Tehran was up to something in response to Israel’s successful strike in Syria that eliminated some top Iranian General’s who were leading Hezbollah units, President Biden publicly told the Iranian’s “Don’t”._
**[Devotional: Where does strength come from in trying times?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
** _On January 3, 2024, my wife, Sherrie, received a diagnosis that turned our reality upside down and changed our lives forever. She was diagnosed with terminal brain cancer, and the news was devastating and incredibly difficult to process._ [**READ MORE COMMENTARY**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**Feel like you have a unique story or commentary to share?** We'd love to talk with you about becoming a RMV Contributor. Reply to this email (or reach out to [brian@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:brian@rockymountainvoice.com)) or send us a message on social media to chat!
# 🏔️ DID YOU KNOW?

The song, “**America the Beautiful** ,” written by Katherine Lee Bates, was inspired by the views she saw from Pike’s Peak. Surprisingly, the Pikes Peak Highway goes all the way to the top year round, weather pending (unlike Mt Evans Byway, which closes from late October to May).
**QUOTE OF THE DAY** "Some people look for a beautiful place. Others make a place beautiful." – Hazrat Inayat Khan

Here's a rundown of the anti-2A proposals under consideration (and of where these bills stand after the weekend's votes): An "Assault Weapons Ban" targeting the majority of commonly used firearms. The "Sensitive Spaces" bill, restricting public carry almost entirely statewide. Increased requirements for concealed carry permits, moving away from constitutional carry. Mandating gun merchants to obtain a costly state permit in addition to federal licenses. A proposed 11% excise tax on firearms and ammunition. Compulsory liability insurance for law-abiding gun owners. Allocation of taxpayer funds to create a "gun police" task force. Mandating locked storage for firearms left in vehicles and tracking gun purchases via credit and debit cards. Support from citizens is crucial, both in the immediate battle and for the long-term defense of Second Amendment rights. If you'd like to get involved, reach out to or . Also, make sure you ASAP to tell them your opposition! Have a great week, Heidi Ganahl | STATE The results of reintroduction of gray wolves into western areas of Colorado is drawing the ire of many Republican members of the State Legislature, several of whom earn a living from livestock. House Democrats voted to pass three gun bills late on Saturday night, including one that would require gun owners to obtain a liability insurance policy for their firearms. Independence Institute President Jon Caldara has become well known for his willingness to take issues directly to the voters, and one topic has catapulted to the top of his “must do” list. War and violence are never the answer to resolving international disputes, a statement from the Colorado Libertarian Party reads. The party has issued a statement condemning escalating conflict in the Middle East and calling for a peaceful resolution between Israel, Hamas and Iran. NATIONAL The first week of former President Donald Trump’s criminal trial has concluded, and a full jury has been chosen — twelve jurors and six alternates. Beginning next week, they’ll put to the test Trump’s contention that he can’t get a fair trial in liberal Manhattan. The State of the Union Address may not have had the result for President Joe Biden that he would have hoped. Emerson polling finds that his job approval rating has continued to slide since the address, and his job disapproval rating has continued to rise. Twelve news organizations on Sunday urged presumptive presidential nominees Joe Biden and Donald Trump to agree to debates, saying they were a “rich tradition” that have been part of every general election campaign since 1976. LOCAL A rancher in Elbert County, Colorado, contacted Colorado Parks and Wildlife after discovering a wolf-like animal in a legal coyote trap on April 3 on a ranch in eastern Colorado. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and United Airlines have launched investigations after a video reportedly showed an “unauthorized person” in the flight deck during a Colorado Rockies flight. The 12 students and one teacher killed in the Columbine High School shooting will be remembered Friday in a vigil on the eve of the 25th anniversary of the tragedy. ## House OKs Aid Package for Ukraine, Israel
The House passed a series of bills Saturday to provide [$95 billion in aid](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvgzAQRn-N2YzM2TF08NCFLV07ogOOcI2xEb4E9d9Xydztkz7p6el9X4crcuR0-8KNgix5wEn4SYPTABrc4Ko5LERAtqLQtI1tu4-mg2oNrQdnLXkPtnGzpcW7xXVEbrLN6JdLxQEMOOMATHfxFur50oG3SGMLXWsMKmdoZslH_ZM5yUpL_M1POuopb1UMq8helP1U0Cvoz_OspzROr1NB_0Ir6I17bwX9mh-F9I6lUNGP-4GcSHM5kKIW5BOTRp71noWSMEYtfJd81yMmXa-yxeoI835yjFx8q5y5bcjxrSL_hvkLAAD__zNEY48) to Ukraine, Israel, and Taiwan, as well as a measure forcing the sale of Chinese company-owned TikTok. | | | Peter, I got a favor to ask you. [My friend and former Senate counsel Josh Riley is running for Congress in NY-19, and his next deadline is this week. Will you join me right now by splitting a contribution of $20 or more between Josh Riley and Blue Amp Action?](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te98326e9-c366-4148-b9ea-ee6349342e2b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3cc5d414-2e72-4e2f-b572-2688fcbe5b34/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) I can’t say enough good things about Josh. Josh is the hardest working person I know. Together we passed bills expanding rights for survivors of domestic abuse and providing new funding for addiction treatment and mental health programs. We also made a lot of Republican witnesses look very bad. **Josh really cares about all the stuff I care about – and probably the stuff you care about too!**

So this is pretty much the full package: a great candidate who will always do what’s right, and a big race we absolutely have to win. [Can Josh and I count on your support? The next big fundraising deadline of Josh’s campaign is coming up, and all eyes are on him. Please split a contribution between Blue Amp Action and Josh’s campaign today.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8dea8662-9ffd-45de-bcf6-14d793c76de5/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thanks, Al **[PS - As you may know, I always end with a P.S. that’s just an excuse for another ask. # US Funds War Industry Without Constitutional Declaration; Biden Issues New Trans Bathroom Law While Congress Preoccupied
Dear ,

The Constitution is an "expressed powers" document of highest binding power and authority in America.

That means, unless a power of the United States is expressly stated in clear terms in the Constitution itself, no Act of Congress or the President is lawful that arrogates any powers to itself.

**MOCO FORUM - DAN COX LEADS WITH PLEDGE TO NOT FUND UKRAINE WAR**
Saturday, I had just stepped off the stage at the well-attended Montgomery County GOP Sixth District Congressional Forum where I vigorously opposed funding of foreign wars - opposing ANY funding to Ukraine - only to hear that the Republican House did indeed use Democrats to pass $65 BILLION of your tax dollars to be given to Ukraine for War.

Congress has done this without listening to those who elected them (the "GOP" Speaker ignored our caucus and caucused with Dems, bringing the Biden agenda to the Floor for the vote!) and without a Constitutional declaration of war under Article I, section 8 of the Constitution. Going to war includes direct funding of a foreign war and that is exactly what your Congress is doing - all without any authority to do so.

Mark my words - Congress has already illegally funded over $110 BILLION dollars to an undeclared US proxy war in Ukraine, and Ukraine is losing badly, having squandered much of the money. _Another $65 BILLION of your tax dollars is meaningless and not only a waste - it could mean expanded war_. Washington is openly talking about nuclear war. This is horrific and wrong. We demand peace through strength, not bleeding our country dry of our hard-earned tax dollars.

And certainly not to foment a possible World War III.

While Congress just yesterday funded nearly $100 BILLION to foreign powers, they funded nothing to stop the invasion on our Southern Border nor did they pass a single measure seeking to lower inflation. Article I, section 10 provides that any State so invaded may defend itself whenever actually invaded or under imminent danger of the same. This is what Texas has declared is occurring and yet, Biden and the GOP-led House of Representatives have joined together to ignore this invasion on our own land.

**PARENTAL HORROR - BIDEN CHANGES AMERICAN LAW ON BOYS IN GIRLS BATHROOMS**
While Congress was busy handing out your money, Biden issued an unconstitutional fiat that Title IX is now to be used AGAINST WOMEN and for advancing K-12 and College discrimination action against anyone who opposes MEN AND BOYS IN WOMEN'S BATHROOMS AND SHOWERS or who use the wrong pro-nouns in our schools.

If your daughter objects to a man with an erected penis in her locker room shower, under Biden's illegal decree your daughter will be reported and possibly expelled for discrimination - permanently marking her high school or college record with the negative finding.

**_These actions by the U.S. Congress and White House are illegal under the Constitution, outrageously ignorant of history and civilized law, and just plain gross._**

I have pledged that I would not only vote against these measures and any similar, but _I will work the caucus to ensure they do the People's will so that we lead this great and bright nation in honesty and truth for the people, and not for the pervert_. This is not a time to play stupid and dangerous games with DEI, and we have no time to waste to save our nation.

**OPPONENTS LACK FORTITUDE**
Oddly, my opponent is failing to speak out on these issues, along with some others, instead saying at the forum yesterday in essence:

**_"I don't know if I would vote for the Ukraine package - we must defend them, we have an obligation to do so, but _I might look around and see what other's are doing_ before I would decide my vote on that funding..."_**

I couldn't believe my ears...especially when he went on to say we have to govern **_with Democrats_** to get things done that we need to pass right now because of the small GOP majority...

Outrageous. Clearly this weak-willed approach is mistaken. NEVER did Nancy Pelosi do such a thing. Even when she had slim majorities...she never begged Republicans "please pass Obamacare and you can read what is in the bill..." She just did what her own caucus demanded and Republicans howled without any power or ability to even read what was in the bill. If you have The Gavel (and apparently some brass), you rule the House and everything that is voted on is in your power. Period.

I ask you: with Democrats joining Biden, and some Republicans including my opponent joining Biden, to support and fund a foreign war in Ukraine and his woke policies in a bloated unbalanced budget, would you want that kind of leadership representing you? Don't you want strong leadership that with backbone, diligence and reason governs at a time of crisis like we are in?

Don't get me wrong - I personally like almost all those running in this GOP race as most are nice people (except the one who hates on Israel and loves Palestinian protesters, even though they are chanting "death to America."). _But nice won't win the day and save America and our kids from a much more likely draft into war_.

The lines of policy and leadership differences in this race are clear. The extreme Left hope you do not nominate someone who advocates for truth, because they want a clear road to do their own will and not yours. They want zero accountability or legal roadblocks. **_Together, we are the roadblock to their globalist cabal in this race._**

We understand what point we are in as a nation. It is near midnight - we are and could well lose our Republic - and without clear servant leadership opposing this madness with constitutional vigor and backbone, we will no longer have a valid government and constitution worth anything and worse, we will be in World War III caused by warmongers in DC.

But I submit to you - YOU are the leadership needed. Without your help, all could be lost.

Join me today. I have literally two days until our FINAL FEC REPORT before the election.

We need to finish raising the media buy money. THIS IS URGENT. Thank you.

Freedom and Victory,

Hi Friend, It’s Earth Day. If you are like me, you’ve just about had it. You are sick of hearing how important climate action is to a candidate, how dedicated this or that politician is to reducing greenhouse gas emissions, and how committed your city’s sustainability department is to environmental conservation, a healthier planet, and a brighter future. You are almost numb to reading about the economic damage climate change is causing year after year. You know that even this year’s Earth Day theme sounding alarm on how microplastics release toxic chemicals into our food and water sources and circulate through the air we breathe will not change our corrupt lawmakers’ mode of operation. Just as organizations across the globe had been preparing to honor and celebrate our remarkable planet,**the most powerful parliament in the world—our own Congress—passed a bill to dedicate another $95 billion to wars.** On top of exacerbating human suffering and aiding Israel’s apartheid, this financial infusion alone will dwarf any federal efforts dedicated to reducing fossil fuel emissions this year. **On this Earth Day, I want to honor these 37 U.S. House Representatives who voted against wars, violence, and environmental destruction that $95 billion in bombs, offensive weapons, and other unconditional military aid will cause. Remember their names.**
---
[ ](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=j5fNBxs3a3N4qD2Ew7zDqIVf6g-l4FLVqwvq1vwG43XdtoRCV0vQBXLNTs-Z52oOCGJqlPF1Rt7Y4-fBqetktWC1aqaTD1bagduSMeYu4rwwlws6uU7A_kHdnS7L8h0l&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=042224_earth_day&n=2)
---
I’ve been a climate action organizer for years and it pains me to see the hypocrisy of too many politicians.**I’m running for the U.S. Senate to offer you the integrity and commitment needed to treat the climate crisis with the seriousness it deserves.** Because I’m unbossed and unbought, you can count on me never to vote to line the pockets of the Raytheons, Lockheed Martins, or Boeings of this world who see every geopolitical conflict as a market opportunity and whose sheer existence endangers our planet and us as species. With just 22 days to go, I need your help to win the primary election. **Nearly 5,000 new donors joined us in the last month alone. Our polls make us cautiously optimistic, but it will be tight.** **[Can you chip in $27.98—our average donation—to help us supercharge the last days of voter outreach?](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=j5fNBxs3a3N4qD2Ew7zDqIVf6g-l4FLVqwvq1vwG43XdtoRCV0vQBXLNTs-Z52oOCGJqlPF1Rt7Y4-fBqetktWC1aqaTD1bagduSMeYu4rwwlws6uU7A_kHdnS7L8h0l&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=042224_earth_day&n=3)** West Virginia is ready to send a working-class candidate to the U.S. Senate. clean_body: If you are like me, you’ve just about had it. | | | Hi Friend, It’s Earth Day. If you are like me, you’ve just about had it. You are sick of hearing how important climate action is to a candidate, how dedicated this or that politician is to reducing greenhouse gas emissions, and how committed your city’s sustainability department is to environmental conservation, a healthier planet, and a brighter future. You are almost numb to reading about the economic damage climate change is causing year after year. You know that even this year’s Earth Day theme sounding alarm on how microplastics release toxic chemicals into our food and water sources and circulate through the air we breathe will not change our corrupt lawmakers’ mode of operation. Just as organizations across the globe had been preparing to honor and celebrate our remarkable planet,the most powerful parliament in the world—our own Congress—passed a bill to dedicate another $95 billion to wars. On top of exacerbating human suffering and aiding Israel’s apartheid, this financial infusion alone will dwarf any federal efforts dedicated to reducing fossil fuel emissions this year. On this Earth Day, I want to honor these 37 U.S. House Representatives who voted against wars, violence, and environmental destruction that $95 billion in bombs, offensive weapons, and other unconditional military aid will cause. Remember their names. I’ve been a climate action organizer for years and it pains me to see the hypocrisy of too many politicians.I’m running for the U.S. Senate to offer you the integrity and commitment needed to treat the climate crisis with the seriousness it deserves. Because I’m unbossed and unbought, you can count on me never to vote to line the pockets of the Raytheons, Lockheed Martins, or Boeings of this world who see every geopolitical conflict as a market opportunity and whose sheer existence endangers our planet and us as species. With just 22 days to go, I need your help to win the primary election. Nearly 5,000 new donors joined us in the last month alone. Our polls make us cautiously optimistic, but it will be tight. body:
| | | |
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: April 22, 2024
---
| Contact: Mark Warner mark@ascent-strategic.com; 317-417-7556
---
| SHELBY COUNTY PROSECUTOR BRAD LANDWERLEN ENDORSES JAMISON CARRIER FOR CONGRESS
---
| Greenwood, IN \- Today, Jamison Carrier, a businessman from Greenwood, announced that Shelby County Prosecutor Brad Landwerlen has endorsed his campaign to replace Congressman Greg Pence, who is retiring at the end of his term in 2024.
Prosecutor Brad Landwerlen's Statement:
"So many of us have had our families devastated by drugs - and in particular fentanyl. I have lost family members to fentanyl. Jamison Carrier and his wife lost their son, Joey, to the same scourge, just 2 years ago. These (and many other) losses drive me to seek serious penalties on drug dealers who deal death, and I see the same drive in Jamison Carrier to hold these dealers/killers accountable by seeking tougher sentences. He is also driven by these deaths to address the open borders that are allowing these deadly drugs to flow easily into the United States and kill our citizens - all to the benefit of the Mexican cartels and China. As Shelby County Prosecutor, I strongly and proudly endorse Jamison Carrier for Congress."

Friend \--

I wish things would have gone a different way...

This is probably the hardest email I've ever written.

**I 'm Mayra Flores, the America First Hispanic woman running in the biggest race in the nation.**

After we made history and flipped a blue seat red for the first time in 100 years, the Democrats threw the kitchen sink at me, **and I had to concede my race. ** | **Democrat Vicente Gonzalez holds back Republican surge, returns 34th Congressional District to Democratic control.**
---

Everyone expected me to just walk away - _but I 'm not someone who ever, ever gives up._

I'm taking a leap of faith here and have thrown my name on the ballot once again.

The Democrats overpowered us in this race before - _and now all indicators are pointing toward this election being a complete toss-up._

My stomach is in knots - **the Democrats have already raised an astonishing $30 MILLION, and Biden just raised $80 million bucks**(I know, I can't believe anyone would give him money either...but they do).

**That 's why I'm humbly asking for your help: _[Will you step up and chip in just a few bucks in the next hour to help us counter this massive Left-wing onslaught?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3je4aou8vjgu4ma33pis6q9msbq54keolvfssn8_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c3g6cob2c9h2bs "Will you step up and chip in just a few bucks in the next hour to help us counter this massive Left-wing onslaught?")_**

I'll just tell you: I'm afraid to see what happens if this email doesn't work.

**The Democrats & the media hacks are terrified of me - that's because as a young Hispanic female, I obliterate every woke narrative they push. So, they will truly do anything to destroy me.**

The Democrats know that if they lose the Hispanic vote, it's over for them. _Forever._

I'm opening my heart to you here: Please, please help out:
| | | [**CONTRIBUTE**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2ziomjkr0nc66b3up985g5b3n04a5qb3mujgfhsa0_rp22sh2s8i6ep36c3g6cob2c9h2bs)

God bless you, and God bless America.

**Mayra Flores**

name: Ed Markey
subject: An Earth Day Message from me to you, Peter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Massachusetts Democratic State Committee
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Logo.png]
Dear Peter, [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/image0%20Large.jpeg]
Happy Earth Day!
There are a lot of reasons why I’m honored to serve the great Commonwealth of Massachusetts, and its natural beauty holds a special place in my heart. From the world-famous beaches of Cape Cod to the breathtaking Berkshires, Mother Nature is here in all her glory in our communities. When I’m working on Capitol Hill alongside the members of the Massachusetts congressional delegation fighting for the people of the state, I always keep in mind the importance of protecting our natural environment and ensuring a livable future.
Under President Joe Biden, we’ve taken historic strides to protect our air and our drinking water, to promote environmental justice, and to reduce the harmful pollution fueling the climate crisis. The Inflation Reduction Act is the largest climate and clean energy bill ever to pass in American history, and it is already helping to deploy the solar, wind, energy efficiency, offshore wind, battery, and other clean energy technologies that will help bring an end to fossil fuels. But we know there is much more work to do.
Peter, as you know, there is no Planet B. We can’t afford to kick the issue of climate change down the road. We need an intersectional, intergenerational movement mobilizing and organizing to address this global challenge. That’s why, five years ago, I partnered with Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez to introduce the Green New Deal, a resolution that is transforming our national climate agenda by creating new union jobs, delivering long-overdue justice, and reducing emissions. It’s a winning strategy: 89% of Americans [https://www.dataforprogress.org/blog/2024/2/6/five-years-after-its-introduction-the-green-new-deal-is-still-incredibly-popular] support at least one of the policies put forward in the Green New Deal. We’re already seeing these popular policies take effect in Massachusetts: in Boston, a Green New Deal was put into place for all public schools, and every new or renovated municipal building must operate without fossil fuels [https://www.boston.gov/news/mayor-michelle-wu-signs-executive-order-banning-fossil-fuels-new-city-owned-buildings] .
Peter, this Earth Day, I’m proud of the work we’ve done, and I’m energized for the work that lies ahead. In every race, up and down every ballot, it is critical that we vote for candidates who recognize that it is our responsibility to combat the climate crisis and enact solutions in all of our 351 cities and towns. In 2024, let’s resolve to protect and defend every inch of our state’s natural beauty for generations to come.
Senator Ed Markey

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: Why you get so many emails
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1363%2E135344%2EFKY8M2)

Friend --
Sometimes it shocks me that anyone donates to fundraising emails from political campaigns.
If you're anything like me, you open your email in the morning and it's overflowing with emails from every Senate campaign, House campaign, the presidential campaign, party committees, and organizations you know and likely many you've never heard of. Most of the time I haven’t signed up for these lists.
I get why these emails happen: they are an increasingly important part of how campaigns and organizations are funded. Especially on the Democratic side. Our small dollar, online, and texting programs are light-years more productive than the GOP, and often account for a third of our monthly fundraising.
So in a sea of Democratic emails and texts, I do my best to differentiate our content, and edit every single one, including this one. The fact that you opened this email instead of deleting it and made it this far gives me hope there's a chance.
There is no winning the Senate without this race in Michigan. There is no winning the White House either. At the same time, this is going to be one of the most competitive (and expensive) races in the country. Poll after poll shows it razor tight.
Republicans know that too, that is why they'll put ridiculous amounts of money in to beat us. And since I don’t accept corporate PAC money, I have to rely on the generosity of individuals like you who understand the stakes of this race.

Friend,

I grew up in Brooklyn as the son of an exterminator and a stay-at-home mom, and a descendant of victims of the Holocaust. My friend Jacky Rosen grew up in a working-class family as the granddaughter of Jewish immigrants and the daughter of a World War II veteran.
Today, I have the great privilege and responsibility of serving as the first Jewish Senate majority leader in our nation’s history, and Jacky is the only Jewish woman currently serving in the U.S. Senate.
**Don’t ever tell me that things can’t change.**

Our humble origins and shared Jewish faith are at the core of what motivates our work together in the Senate. Every day, we’re fighting to make progress on the real issues Americans face: lowering everyday costs for families, combating hate and discrimination, and restoring reproductive freedom.
But the GOP has a different vision for America, which is why they’re trying to defeat Jacky and enact their toxic agenda.

Right now, Republicans are targeting Jacky’s seat in battleground Nevada as the key to Senate control. Mitch McConnell personally selected an extreme GOP opponent to run against her, and he just set a new fundraising record. Donald Trump has been campaigning aggressively in Nevada to rally support from his MAGA base.
**We can’t let the only Jewish woman serving in the Senate stand against the full force of the GOP alone. But with polling showing Jacky tied neck and neck with her opponent right now, she needs all the help she can get to fight back. That’s why I’m personally reaching out to ask for your support:**
**[Will you please join me in supporting Jacky's reelection campaign by giving $5 or more now? Every dollar will make a critical difference in keeping Nevada blue, defending our Senate majority, and ensuring that Jacky and I can both continue making progress for the American people.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83478847/468531021/2034486384?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk3731-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYTgyYjhmNS1hODAwLWVmMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vlBJ6TjIGymy_Gu0NZ48jA_8S9k8ZPJgCPthzPmWtw0=)**

name: Jenny Beth Martin, Tea Party Patriots Action
subject: Apr. 22 CTA: Defend Justice Clarence Thomas – again!
body:
The left wants to manipulate a SCOTUS ruling
| | | |
---
|
---
| Patriot-

---
| **** It's happening again. The liberal left thinks they can influence what should be a nonpartisan decision through manipulation and intimidation.
And who is their target? Justice Clarence Thomas, again. Why? Because on April 25, 2024, the Supreme Court will be hearing arguments on whether the left will be able to continue persecuting Donald Trump by criminally prosecuting Donald Trump.
MoveOn.org is raising money to take out **_front-page ads_** in _The Washington Post_ demanding that Justice Clarence Thomas recuse himself from the decision under the guise that his wife, Ginni, has been politically involved in favor of President Donald Trump.
How ironic that an organization that hates President Trump wants to stack the Supreme Court with people who also hate him in order to get a "fair" ruling. These are the tactics of the left: They cry for unbiased neutrality while actually manipulating the rules and the system to get what they want. They behave like petulant children who throw themselves on the ground in the grocery store because Mommy wouldn't buy them a candy bar.
They are attempting to raise $25,000 to take over the front page ad space in the April 25, _Washington Post_ paper to humiliate Justice Thomas, and his wife, and try to bully him into recusing himself - **and we can 't let that happen.** [****](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb97947f965ce9/1edb97947f958e4a) **** ************

We've done this before and we'll do it again - must let our government know that you appreciate and want Justice Thomas to remain on the Supreme Court and that these lies and accusations cannot stand._you_
** _
_****_[Sign our petition](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb97947f965ce9/1edb97947f958e50 "Sign our petition")_****and write a letter to your local newspaper editor** telling them that you support one of the greatest Supreme Court Justices in the history of our country, [****](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb97947f965ce9/1edb97947f958e52) **** ************

| **SAMPLE LETTER TO THE EDITOR**
---
| **** ___Dear Editor,__
__It has come to my attention as an American citizen that there are people looking to sully the good name of Supreme Court Justice Clarence Thomas in order to force an outcome in our judicial system rather than allow unbiased opinion rulings.__
__I 'm here to tell you that Justice Thomas is one of the greatest Supreme Court Justices this country has ever had, and the American people stand by and support him both in and out of the courtroom.__
__No radical group should use pressure and manipulation to force an outcome in any area of our government, and as a counter to this insanity I want to say that I support Justice Clarence Thomas and appreciate the job he does for our nation.__
__Thank you for taking the time to read my letter.__
__Have a wonderful day.___ [****](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb97947f965ce9/1edb97947f958e54) **** ************

subject: It doesn’t make any sense
body:

Dear
Fellow Patriot,

I believe
that America stands at a crossroads. Our individual freedoms, the
nation's respect for the Constitution, and the legacy of our
Founders are all enduring relentless assaults. Shifts in our
society threaten to dilute our nation's character while biased
media and divisive politics amplify it greater than ever.

The
people that this impacts the most are not you and I-It is our
future generation. Our children and grandchildren are being
taught that that is their skin that defines them, not the content
of their character. They are being taught that our nation's
history is something to be ashamed of.

Candidly,
it just doesn't make any sense.

But, I
believe we can change this. I believe we can build a future that
upholds the values of faith, liberty, community, and life - a
future where all Americans are free to pursue their ideas, goals,
and faith.

This
won't be possible without your involvement. I've created a simple
pledge; a way to align us all around a set of shared beliefs. I
want to invite you to take the Common Sense Pledge.

We cannot
bring about this necessary change without you. By signing this
pledge, you are committing to uphold the principles our nation
was founded on and teach them to the next generations. Just one
person can make a difference, and it can start with you.

This is
not a passive petition; it's an active pledge to uphold the
common sense values that shaped our great nation.

Sign the
Common Sense Pledge today using this secure link:
https://offers.americancornerstone.org/common-sense-pledge/

Together,
we can shape a future that respects our shared history, protects
our hard-earned freedoms, and prioritizes common sense. Your
involvement is critical - are you ready to take action?

Sincerely,

Dr. Ben
Carson
Founder
and Chairman
American
Cornerstone Institute

Your
donation to ACI helps us to focus on our mission of promoting and
preserving individual and religious liberty, helping our
country's most vulnerable find new hope, and developing methods
to decrease the federal government's role in society and to
improve efficiency to best serve ALL our nation's citizens.

Fellow Conservative,

Hollywood funding Democrat candidates for Congress is a tale as old as the movie industry itself.

You and I both know how rare it is for a celebrity in Hollywood to support conservative candidates for federal office - it’s even more rare for them to offer their support publicly. But quite frankly, I couldn’t care less about winning the support of Hollywood actors, directors, or anyone involved with the entertainment industry.

**My opponent, on the other hand, is actively soliciting their financial support.**

I have received emails from actress Glenn Close on two occasions. In her fundraising appeals on behalf of Jon Tester’s campaign, she writes, _**“Jon Tester is running for reelection in Montana—it’s the most important race on the map. This election will determine the future of our country, and I can’t sit on the sidelines with stakes as high as these.”**_

My opponent, on the other hand, is actively soliciting their financial support. I have received emails from actress Glenn Close on two occasions. This election will determine the future of our country, and I can’t sit on the sidelines with stakes as high as these.” Please consider a contribution to my campaign today. Is it the Hollywood, coastal California elite, or the people of Montana who sent him to Washington to be their voice? With A-LIST Hollywood celebrities on his team, there is no telling the amount of resources Tester will be able to marshal over the next seven months. I appreciate your help with this matter. | Dear Friends and Neighbors,

It’s a perfect spring morning throughout Pennsylvania's 7th Congressional District. What a blessing it is to live in such a beautiful place.

When I first announced my candidacy for Congress, I issued a challenge to my fellow Republicans. Will they nominate the person with the best qualifications, or will they choose another career politician with insider credentials? The response will define our local politics for decades and could have a profound impact on the future of our country.

I’m an experienced leader in business, military, and civic affairs. I already have a successful career in the private sector and don’t need this job to pay my bills. I'm backed by friends and family, an amazing team, hundreds of incredible volunteers, thousands of small donors, and patriots throughout the district.

In Washington, I’ll be an independent, conservative voice for you. I won’t rely on House leadership or DC bureaucrats to tell me how to vote. Instead, I’ll listen to my neighbors and draw from my years of relevant experience to make wise decisions. I’m interested in changing things for the better, not advancing my career.

This separates me from my opponents. Neither has served in the military or started their own business. They are products of the establishment, who seem too excited about going to Washington and being a part of that insider scene.

Not me. I’m approaching this like a military deployment. Nobody wants to go off to war. And nobody should be eager to enter that cesspool of Washington politics. But I’m trained to fight for our freedoms, I’ve been through hardship before, and I’m ready to answer the call. I’ve served my country in uniform. Now I’m ready to serve in Congress.

Real-world experience isn’t just important to GOP voters. It’s important to all voters. And that’s why I’m best positioned to defeat Susan Wild in November.

In contrast to the name-calling and mudslinging of my opponents, I ran a clean campaign, and I hope you noticed. I did that because you deserve leaders who don’t need to lie to get elected, and to set an example for my family. I want my sons to see how their dad reacts to false accusations: by telling the truth.

I am asking for your vote please, and your prayers. I'm confident that we ran a successful campaign and are positioned to win. This election is in God’s hands.

Thank you and God Bless.

**Keep America Free.**

_Kevin Dellicker is a Republican from Heidelberg Township, Lehigh County, running for U.S. House of Representatives in Pa.’s 7th District. He is a 28-year military veteran, technology company owner, husband and father. He’s not a career politician. He’s a proven leader with the experience and courage to Keep America Free. Learn more at[www.dellickerforcongress.com](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=51f54973dc&e=1090c5c412)._

| JAMISON CARRIER RELEASES BORDER PLEDGE; CALLS ON FENTANYL TO BE CLASSIFIED AS WMD
---
| Greenwood, IN \- In an opinion editorial published in the American Conservative this weekend titled "[Fentanyl: The New Litmus Test for Republican Candidates](https://fwpz5zgbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001-vM12Ut3Sxx5OLXsIDwH_z-KibsyC2olTMKyt43tD-OXrnvCAhgxiGVGo7eVLUF--6ZOBXcvjglDzyNcqow9ha42iTmDu3_564kDjDA3Mnabqs1ZL-Ar9fCbN9g_U0SWproAYI16pOC3wOY7AMCC5TYpYfU66GQj15bNmCiia8gCucX_KiQD9gQjJdz1eG3vU8IO37UAynL0hm4uUMSJt60Nk2Vej3L89qJSh3htc-o=&c=ElgLl9TwxJXkkRNCXxZSf_2x_SK0hmxzCYIm9FcpydVSe8xDelQUTQ==&ch=PMrZ-SzkJUGHUCFyyqmdjaXDKiMMcmgMWYSBiYU_KDXU2poJQGJFag==)," Jamison Carrier, a businessman and Republican congressional candidate from Indiana's 6th Congressional District, proposed a border pledge for Americans to demand of any candidate or politician running for office:
"That's why I'm proposing a pledge to our homeland--a litmus test, if you will--for Americans to demand of any candidate or politician who asks them for their vote:
1. Secure the border 2. Call for the classification of fentanyl as a Weapon of Mass Destruction 3. Hold domestic and international dealers accountable for deaths and enact stricter penalties
These are simple promises, the bare minimum to protect our children, our national security, and our sovereignty as a nation."
Two years ago, on April 15th, Kathy and Jamison lost their son Joey to fentanyl poisoning. Fentanyl is manufactured in China and brought to our country by Mexican cartels through our open southern border.
Border security and stopping the flow of immigrants and deadly drugs from coming into our country due to Biden's border crisis continues to be a top issue for voters. In the op-ed, Jamison stated, "As our border remains flooded with deadly drugs that are destroying our families and killing our children, it's no surprise that immigration and border security are the top issues for voters. Yet our president and so many in Congress sit as bystanders from their perches in Washington as deaths surge."
Jamison ends the op-ed with, "No family should have to experience what we have. I will fight tooth and nail to end this mass poisoning of our country's sons and daughters. And anyone asking to represent or lead you should commit to do the same."
[Read the entire op-ed published by the American Conservative by clicking here.](https://fwpz5zgbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001-vM12Ut3Sxx5OLXsIDwH_z-KibsyC2olTMKyt43tD-OXrnvCAhgxiGVGo7eVLUF-iBEOLqN2CFVjqttnOkNyOhOg7Y54tKG4-PIAGjyIH7roTLgtjgw5cLzEiJ4Fm5T88n2RyCaBQZrFnXy0F1E2vdF7qjaHniEo3dJZWztKzeBtnzxd7_hRYE8vBQf0rnPcqlbuf2shpLRAyPWkjOXZjyeJXpWiB8goNr34rh8QNm6j7xSO_9PbJ7OuX0yJ8AJcBqza5_x5h-tz-yv6qckUy20Pj6Qi25LOUij81ASuh0Li9VDobIlvWJooh4fvbrfYDkxwnh5IRJngNpn02guAWt0d_7NKgEyFUrw5I7nogBVWCBWlHe8hdXly5fGjr0Lvt-_Pybg-ETdyKnOjC-HS9A6PsjusTr-QUyRUtYPBIhXbw397sEOYoKgrlhcpSt_xqOyLMp6esMciHdcdyQk9P6ZmPo6GcdJy&c=ElgLl9TwxJXkkRNCXxZSf_2x_SK0hmxzCYIm9FcpydVSe8xDelQUTQ==&ch=PMrZ-SzkJUGHUCFyyqmdjaXDKiMMcmgMWYSBiYU_KDXU2poJQGJFag==)

Rick doesn’t answer to the folks in DC. He is in the Senate to fight for you – not the special interests in Washington. That’s why Rick has been labeled “The Least Popular Man in Washington.”

Rick wants to change the status quo in Washington DC, and most Americans agree.
