name: LCV Earth Day Alert
subject: Open Today: On Earth Day, the Earth could really use your help.
body:
__Our campaign for clean air is counting on you. |
---

|
Today is Earth Day, Peter. YOU can help protect our planet by [renewing your LCV membership for just $5.](https://links.messages.lcv.)

As environmentalists like you take this time to celebrate our planet and its precious climate, **extreme MAGA Republicans are preparing votes to allow corporate polluters to dirty our air and throw open our public lands to drill, mine,_and worse_.**

Our movement -- made up of millions of people like you -- is the only thing stopping them. It's what gives LCV our power when we're on Capitol Hill _every day_ , meeting with members of Congress and hitting back against intense lobbying from Big Oil and other corporate polluters who push lawmakers to put their profits ahead of our planet.

The truth is that we need YOUR help to go toe-to-toe with corporate lobbyists and win, Peter: [renew your LCV membership for just $5 in honor of Earth Day to help us reach our $10,000 goal by midnight tonight >>](https://links.messages.lcv.)
_For a limited time, we 'll send you an exclusive (and eco-friendly!) tote bag, so you can show your support for our movement and our climate wherever you go._ Just make your donation monthly -- everyone who makes a monthly gift of $19 or more will receive their tote bag absolutely free.

[](https://links.messages.lcv.)
|
---
**[**RENEW NOW >>**](https://links.messages.lcv.)**

This threat is serious, Peter. On Friday, the Senate rejected an effort to thwart the Biden-Harris administration's historic standards to limit emissions from cars -- _currently the leading source of greenhouse gases in the U.S._ -- on our roads and highways. **But the next time legislation to block the cleaner cars rule comes up in the Senate, Big Oil and their extreme allies will need just 50 votes to win instead of 60,** and despite losing this time, they had 52 votes on their side on Friday. Truth is, _we need to ratchet up the pressure_ on swing Senators if we want to win the next vote, too.

**If these and other extreme attempts to block action to combat climate change move forward, our health and climate will suffer for generations.**

[The best thing you can do for our planet's future right now is to renew your LCV membership for just $5 to power our campaign for clean air >>](https://links.messages.lcv.)

We're so grateful for your support on Earth Day and every day. Together, we have the power to make a real difference for our planet.

Onward,

LCV Membership Team

---

Fellow American, it’s me, Elise Stefanik.

We’re in the fight of our lives to take back CA-9 from the grips of liberal Democrat Josh Harder. \*\*That’s why I’m reaching out to you today in support of my friend Kevin Lincoln.\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=5580900.2427.1.565d3c6af4e757199aeeb1dc2f9f88a7 )

-> \*\*HELP US FLIP THIS SEAT »\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=5580900.2428.1.61e39f13292fa9c7620391d7827cc37f )<-

As a Marine Corps veteran and Mayor of Stockton, California, Kevin is the embodiment of conservative values and unwavering dedication to our nation. And I’m endorsing his campaign because he is exactly the kind of leader we need in Washington.

Kevin is our GOP nominee in this race, and he has what it takes to flip this \*\*TOP PRIORITY\*\* seat because he’s already proven he can win in a blue state. \*\*But he needs your support to take on the liberal establishment desperate to hold this vulnerable seat.\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=5580900.2429.1.a1ec357a30c68f7ffe420a409031c10b )

-> \*\*HELP US FLIP THIS SEAT »\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=5580900.2430.1.ddbbbecc58c8e026a36e4b44582c3cb5 )<-

_Myself, Majority Leader Steve Scalise, and Speaker Mike Johnson all agree_ – \*\*we need Kevin working alongside us in Washington, D.C. to continue delivering wins for the American People.\*\*

\*\*Join me in supporting Kevin Lincoln for Congress today by contributing $10 to his campaign.\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=5580900.2431.1.6d85151de8b290cec0acb14e8098e7c9 )

Thank you for your support.

Elise Stefanik

House GOP Conference Chair

->

->\*\*Meet Kevin Lincoln

\*\*<-

My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

Here’s why that’s important: **Republican Party officials in Travis County are trying to stack the Board with right-wing figures that could jeopardize funding for our local schools, parks, and public safety agencies. **
We know the Trump playbook— cut services for working people so you can cut taxes for the wealthiest. We can’t let that happen.
So what can you do to make sure we win this critical race?

**👉****PLAN TO VOTE** \- Today, April 22nd, is the first day of early voting, and Election Day is on May 4th. Mark your calendar, make a plan, and go vote early!
**👉****SPREAD THE WORD** \- Talk to your friends, family, and neighbors about the stakes of this race and encourage them to vote.
We can’t let far-right, partisan figures dictate Travis County’s future. We need experienced local leaders who will fight for our schools, our parks, and our local government services.

Thank you for being in this fight,

-Greg

name: Bryan
subject: Campaign Update
body:
Here’s an update from a week that included a fantastic event in Beloit, a key endorsement, and a new opponent. | | | | |
---
We are officially less than 200 days away from Election Day.
Here’s an update from a week that included a fantastic event in Beloit, a key endorsement, and a new opponent.
**Lincoln Day Dinner with Rock and Walworth County** After a busy week in Washington, I spent my Saturday evening with friends in Beloit. It was a great opportunity to talk about the global challenges facing our country.
Our volunteers in Walworth and Rock County are doing a fantastic job connecting with voters and spreading our message ahead of the November election. I’m enormously grateful for their hard work.
**Kenosha Professional Police Association Endorsement** Last week, I was honored to receive the endorsement of the Kenosha Professional Police Association.
I will never waver in my support for the men and women of law enforcement. I believe that supporting law enforcement is critical to the safety of our communities.
I consider supporting policies that ensure the safety and security of our communities a key responsibility for any member of Congress.
**My New Opponent** Peter Barca, who’s been a politician for 40 years, announced he’s running against me in the First Congressional District.
Peter Barca first ran for office in 1984. He was on the same ballot as Walter Mondale.
During his time in public office, he has has repeatedly supported policies that hurt families in Wisconsin.
**He voted to raise the gas tax** , and didn’t use the money to build roads and bridges.
**He voted to protect sanctuary cities in Wisconsin** , which allow municipalities to ignore federal immigration laws.
He’s wrong on the issues. And he’s wrong for Wisconsin.
**But he’s going to have a ton of resources from National Democrats and dark money groups.**
If you’re willing and able to help me out, I’d greatly appreciate any support you can show my campaign.
[Click Here to Donate My Campaign](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=8c46380794&e=e907534017)
We’re also always looking for more volunteers to help us knock doors, walk in parades, and collect nomination signatures.
[Click Here to Volunteer with Team Steil](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=48cefb0e44&e=e907534017)

This should set off alarms everywhere. ⏰
* Yass is in tight with Trump. Not only is he Trump’s top pick for Treasury Secretary, he even got a shout-out from [Trump calling him “fantastic”](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/1fz_lw9He5WBonAZBYLcLw~~/AAPPAAA~~~) and recently [helped him raise MILLIONS!](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/gnmBR1JhZi2nyRyme_XRAA~~/AAPPAAA~)

* Despite Yass’ PAC’s intentionally deceptive name, the “Moderate PAC” is anything but moderate – with [Yass funding a staggering 77%](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/mmonZxYUbIiVbsjh90M62g~~/AAPPAAA~~)! Since when is it okay for [Trump’s anti-abortion financier and potential Treasury Secretary](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/JS5X3tv6Hk0X25-C3tf12g~~/AAPPAAA~/RgRoCVXwP0SsaHR0cHM6Ly9rZXlzdG9uZW5ld3Nyb29tLmNvbS9zdG9yeS9qZWZmcmV5LXlhc3MtdHJ1bXAtYmFpbG91dC8_Y2RtYz0yZlRBbmZMWXd0bVJpbml2anFhTjREUFJvYVomcmVmY29kZTI9MmZUQW5mTFl3dG1SaW5pdmpxYU40RFBSb2FaJnJlZmNvZGVjZG1jPTJmVEFuZkxZd3RtUmluaXZqcWFONERQUm9hWlcDc3BjQgpmEPDQJmaOqi5AUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAaQ~~) to ****LIE TO VOTERS**** about Summer’s record and [associate her with Donald Trump.](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/iw5KphN25fQUtQrFGRAi1A~~/AAPPAAA~/RgRoCVXwP0TNaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuaHVmZnBvc3QuY29tL2VudHJ5L2plZmZyZXkteWFzcy1zdW1tZXItbGVlLWJoYXZpbmktcGF0ZWxfbl82NjE4NWFmMmU0YjAwODMwZTkxNmQ2ZmI_Y2RtYz0yZlRBbmZMWXd0bVJpbml2anFhTjREUFJvYVomcmVmY29kZTI9MmZUQW5mTFl3dG1SaW5pdmpxYU40RFBSb2FaJnJlZmNvZGVjZG1jPTJmVEFuZkxZd3RtUmluaXZqcWFONERQUm9hWlcDc3BjQgpmEPDQJmaOqi5AUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAaQ~~)

[ ](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/JS06XeGSeypjyueGoEs_ug~~/AAPPAAA~) **On top of ALL that, Summer’s Democratic opponent actually asked Republicans to switch parties just to vote against her in the primary.** This is a clear attempt to push out a leader like Summer who has always stood up for what's right—like better jobs, clean air and water, and making sure everyone has a fair shot. [ ](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/JS06XeGSeypjyueGoEs_ug~~/AAPPAAA~) They’re afraid of what Summer stands for because she's tough, she never gives up, and she will always challenge the status quo for the good of the people. **The Republican billionaires know Summer is a strong candidate that won’t be bought out by big money, and they're pulling out every single trick in the book to take her down.** **We have to ask ourselves: why would a Republican spend so much money to help a Democrat? It’s not support, it’s strategy!** Now more than ever, we have to have Summer's back. [**_Your contribution today can make a real difference as we work to inform voters and combat these shady tactics. | | One of the most important legacies we can give to our kids, grandkids, and generations to come is a safe and thriving planet. That means we need to take bold steps today to protect our environment, cut pollution, make our communities more resilient to extreme weather, and protect our planet for our kids and future generations. I voted for the Inflation Reduction Act for a lot of reasons. One of them was that it's the largest investment in American energy independence and job creation in new, green sectors. It also combats climate change through investments in American energy production and does more to combat climate change than any bill in history. **Now, I'm running for Senate to protect our planet and be a vote to help fight climate change.** That's why I've been endorsed by the League of Conservation Voters Action Fund (LCVAF), a national organization dedicated to protecting our environment and electing leaders dedicated to that mission. I'll never forget watching my sons take some of their first steps on Jersey Shore beaches, or camping as a kid in the Pine Barrens. These beautiful, national treasures deserve to be protected for our kids and future generations to enjoy. I hope to continue protecting them and working to make sure New Jersey is a state that fights climate change, replenishes our beaches, and protects ecosystems that keep our shore towns, businesses, and families across New Jersey thriving. clean_body: I’m running for Senate to protect our planet and be a vote to help fight climate change. | | | | One of the most important legacies we can give to our kids, grandkids, and generations to come is a safe and thriving planet. That means we need to take bold steps today to protect our environment, cut pollution, make our communities more resilient to extreme weather, and protect our planet for our kids and future generations. I voted for the Inflation Reduction Act for a lot of reasons. One of them was that it's the largest investment in American energy independence and job creation in new, green sectors. It also combats climate change through investments in American energy production and does more to combat climate change than any bill in history. Now, I'm running for Senate to protect our planet and be a vote to help fight climate change. That's why I've been endorsed by the League of Conservation Voters Action Fund (LCVAF), a national organization dedicated to protecting our environment and electing leaders dedicated to that mission. I'll never forget watching my sons take some of their first steps on Jersey Shore beaches, or camping as a kid in the Pine Barrens. These beautiful, national treasures deserve to be protected for our kids and future generations to enjoy. I hope to continue protecting them and working to make sure New Jersey is a state that fights climate change, replenishes our beaches, and protects ecosystems that keep our shore towns, businesses, and families across New Jersey thriving. = What we do today to fight climate change will provide a cleaner, safer environment to enjoy now and in generations to come. That is a future we can look forward to, and one we can feel proud of when we hand it off to our kids and the next generation of leaders. body:
The Swamp wants foreign countries to own our land. |

| | | | | |

#
Fellow Patriot,

I believe that Missouri land should be owned by Missourians, or, at least, Americans. I believe that we should do everything in our power to protect our military men and women. _This shouldn't be controversial, but The Swamp in Jefferson City is fighting me with everything they've got. _ Kung Pao Mike Kehoe's Chamber of Commerce Cronies have [come out attacking](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=d20ec51529&e=c00a6982d2) my amendment to SB 912, which would ban foreign individuals and corporations from owning farmland within 500 miles of a military facility.

Their reasoning for opposing the bill is because the legislation would, “in effect, prohibit all foreign ownership of Missouri farmland.”

Yes, you read that right. They want foreign countries to be able to buy up our land and they aren't even hiding it. It is no surprise that they endorsed Kung Pao Kehoe, who orchestrated the deal to sell our land to China back in 2013.

Here is [my response](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=5a34b0bded&e=c00a6982d2):

“I believe that Missouri land should be owned by Missourians, or, at least, Americans. I believe our military men and women should be protected. The Missouri Chamber disagrees with that. The Chamber of Cronies endorsed Kung Pao Mike Kehoe, who orchestrated the deal to sell our land to China. My opponents are old guard, America Last politicians.

When I’m governor, I won’t bow to the CCP (Chinese Communist Party) or the Chamber of Cronies. I’ll put Missouri first.”

It's time for a reckoning for globalist Kung Pao Kehoe and his crony regime. Together, we will deliver that reckoning on August 6th.

In Liberty,

| | The spring election is over and it’s time to get serious about November. And here’s why:

**President Biden and Donald Trump are tied in Wisconsin –** that means we need to work ten times as hard to spread the word, get out the vote, and turn WI blue this fall.

**We have new, fair maps that triple the number of competitive districts in our state –** that means we need to triple our resources and triple our organizing efforts if we’re going to flip critical seats in the state legislature.

**Wisconsinites silenced by the WisGOP for over a decade will finally have their voices heard –** and we need to get them (and everyone else) fired up for what’s ahead.

Everything comes down to November, Peter. And with your help, we’re going to win decisive victories up and down the ballot this fall.

As your representative in Congress, I'm all about being there for you and fighting for what matters to our community. Pushing for the policies and issues we care about, to make a real difference.

Thanks for your trust and support—I'm committed to keeping up the good fight for all of us.

Chip in $5, $10, or $15 to my campaign today. **Every dollar matters.**_](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=1c7086bfef&e=a39a20e5dd)

This weekend I voted to pass an essential bipartisan foreign aid package.

We are facing unprecedented threats across the globe. All of which directly impacts us here in Upstate NY, especially our Ukrainian, Jewish, and Israeli-American communities.

This historic, bipartisan deal responds to the need for American leadership abroad advancing freedom and democracy and protecting our interests.
|
---
I joined a bipartisan group in calling on President Biden to immediately address the situation at our southern border.

Securing the border is not a left or right issue. Our cities and communities are being put at risk. The situation is dire. And for what? The chaos of an open border isn't good for the migrants either.

- [Bipartisan group of NY pols call on Biden to finally address US border ‘war zone’ as city’s migrant crisis rages on](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=d87ed71e89&e=a39a20e5dd)
|
---
|
---
The statistics are alarming and tragic. New York 19 has become the epicenter of the opioid crisis with Broome, Greene, and Sullivan counties having some of the highest overdose rates in NYS.

There is a direct connection between open borders, cashless bail and the opioid epidemic. This is the public health crisis of our lifetime and demands emergency action.

President Biden must secure the border.

Governor Hochul must declare a public emergency.

“Catch and Release” at the border is the same as cashless bail in NY: it undermines law enforcement, emboldens criminals and fuels the opioid crisis.

\- ['It's very challenging': Inside the fentanyl fight at the border](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=e9b02d5ba2&e=a39a20e5dd)
- [Molinaro urges Hochul to declare State of Emergency over the opioid crisis](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=e0044d791e&e=a39a20e5dd)
- [Rep. Molinaro calls on Gov. Hochul to declare State of Emergency over opioid overdoses](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=e120bee01f&e=a39a20e5dd)
|
---
|
---
I was proud to vote for - and was pleased to announce - vital funding that helps to provide more opportunity for children in low-income families. Early assistance in education, health and nutrition can play a key role in their future success.

The Daily Star was correct when they said "when we invest in our children, we’re investing in a brighter, more prosperous future for us all."

- [In Our Opinion: Early childhood education is a worthy investment](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=1ede01a1ba&e=a39a20e5dd)

# *ABOVE* Brian Fitzpatrick Congressional Scorecard

_Dear Patriot,_
Have you heard?

Brian Fitzpatrick’s scorecard is _**abysmal**_.
Instead of voting in a way that would represent his constituents and Pennsylvania’s First District, Fitzpatrick has sided with special interest groups, Ukraine, and most of all, the Democrats.
Time and time again, Brian Fitzpatrick has _failed_ his voters. He _fails_ to show up, he _fails_ to host public meetings to be accountable to the voters, and he _fails_ to vote with the interests of Pennsylvania’s First District.
In fact, _**Brian Fitzpatrick votes with the Democrats and Joe Biden a whopping 74% of the time**_. Some Republican he is.
The First District of Pennsylvania deserves a congressman who will have a backbone, and who will stand on principles, even when it’s hard.
That’s the congressman I am running to be. With your help, we can get to work on day one to get our nation back on track.
The primary election is **THIS TUESDAY, APRIL 23RD** , and I _**NEED**_ your vote.
Thank you for your unwavering support.
_**God Bless,**_
_**Mark Houck**_ _**Republican Candidate for Congress, PA-01**_

We thought you may be interested to hear the latest in our ongoing reporting on the Chicago GOP and embattled Chair Stephen Boulton. Continue to follow Illinois Review (https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=33332b5e2a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) for more updates.

** BREAKING: Steve Boulton Says He's Not Running for Chicago GOP Chairman After IR Exposes his Past Comments Comparing Trump to Hitler, Blames "Far Right" for his Downfall (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/breaking-steve-boulton-says-hes-not-running-for-chicago-gop-chairman-after-ir-exposes-his-past-comments-comparing-trump-to-hitler-blames-far-right-for-his-downfall.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=33332b5e2a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/breaking-steve-boulton-says-hes-not-running-for-chicago-gop-chairman-after-ir-exposes-his-past-comments-comparing-trump-to-hitler-blames-far-right-for-his-downfall.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=33332b5e2a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

By Illinois Review

On Monday, disgraced Chicago Republican Party Chairman Steve Boulton announced in an email to ward committee members that he was not seeking re-election as chairman, and blaming the “far right” for his downfall after this publication published a series of damaging stories including one that revealed that in 2016, he posted a comment on social media where he compared President Donald Trump to Adolf Hitler (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/chicago-gop-chair-steve-boulton-calls-ir-reporting-a-smear-campaign-as-il-gop-leaders-don-tracy-richard-porter-ignore-his-comments-comparing-trump-to-hitler.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=33332b5e2a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

In making his announcement, Boulton wrote,

“I announce to you all that I will not be a candidate to run for a second term as your Chair. I fully back Chuck Hernandez of the 38th Ward for Chair!”

Boulton also took aim at this publication, writing that he’s “a bit burned out after what seemed like fighting the whole world for years to create change, including inertia in the Party and maniacal enemies on the far Right.”

The embattled chairman lost his election to save his 27th Ward Committeeman seat this past March after he was originally knocked off the primary ballot for submitting an “insufficient number of valid signatures.” Boulton then tried to run as a write-in candidate, but only received 24 votes (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/chicago-gop-chair-steve-boulton-tries-to-save-ward-committeeman-seat-as-write-in-candidate-secures-only-24-votes-in-humiliating-defeat-without-an-opponent.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=33332b5e2a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) – falling far short of the 111 required to remain a committeeman.

Continue to follow Illinois Review () for more updates. BREAKING: Steve Boulton Says He's Not Running for Chicago GOP Chairman After IR Exposes his Past Comments Comparing Trump to Hitler, Blames "Far Right" for his Downfall () By Illinois Review On Monday, disgraced Chicago Republican Party Chairman Steve Boulton announced in an email to ward committee members that he was not seeking re-election as chairman, and blaming the “far right” for his downfall after this publication published a series of damaging stories including one that revealed that in 2016, he posted a comment on social media where he compared President Donald Trump to Adolf Hitler () . In making his announcement, Boulton wrote, “I announce to you all that I will not be a candidate to run for a second term as your Chair. I fully back Chuck Hernandez of the 38th Ward for Chair!” Boulton also took aim at this publication, writing that he’s “a bit burned out after what seemed like fighting the whole world for years to create change, including inertia in the Party and maniacal enemies on the far Right.” CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () The embattled chairman lost his election to save his 27th Ward Committeeman seat this past March after he was originally knocked off the primary ballot for submitting an “insufficient number of valid signatures.” Boulton then tried to run as a write-in candidate, but only received 24 votes () – falling far short of the 111 required to remain a committeeman. _**Here are just a few achievements from these amazing Emerge alums:**_

_**Cabinet member Deb Haaland**_ made history as the first Native American Secretary of the Interior in the U.S. There, she has built on her career as an advocate and ally of communities disproportionately affected by climate change by making the transition to a just and sustainable economy her top priority. Promoting Indigenous voices on environmental concerns is a must in tackling global climate change.

_**Congresswoman Melanie Stansbury**_ spent nearly two decades of her career dedicated to science-focused work on water and natural resource issues statewide and nationally. From investing in renewable energy to conserving New Mexico’s beautiful landscapes, she is committed to a sustainable future for all in Congress. Congresswoman Stansbury’s seat was previously held by Sec. Deb Haaland, one of the many examples of Emerge’s “Lift As You Climb” efforts.

_**San Francisco Mayor London Breed**_ is the first African-American woman Mayor in San Francisco's history. She is on track to provide San Francisco with 100% renewable energy by 2025 and be carbon net-zero by 2045. This plan is a framework that centers social and racial equity to address the disproportionate impacts of climate change on the City’s vulnerable populations and ensure environmental benefits to all residents.

Emerge women are committed to protect our planet and lay the groundwork to pass meaningful legislation at every level of government. We must ensure every community is represented in the fight against climate change, and support more Democratic climate warriors.

# NOTE FROM AMANDA CHASE
---
| Dear Chesterfield Friends & Supporters, Thanks to those of you who came out tonight to support our new GOP leadership team. We had a record turnout and lots of new faces.
Congratulations to the new executive committee for running an efficient productive meeting. Business meetings will be held monthly going forward. Please visit www.chesterfieldgop for all future meetings, events and information on how to join the committee.
Please submit your application to join the committee online so that you can be voted in at the next monthly meeting. Please find a place to serve so we can turn our county red again.
We want anyone who lives in Chesterfield and votes Republican to consider becoming an active member. Under new leadership, we are asking anyone who votes Republican and wants to make a difference to join the committee if you have not already done so. You can now do so online. We need all hands on deck if we're going to turn our once red county red again.
WE NEED YOU. Now's our chance to grow our Chesterfield GOP and create a red wave in Chesterfield like we've never seen before.
Do you live in Chesterfield County? Please come. Do you vote Republican? Please come. Do you want to make a difference in Chesterfield? Now's your chance
If you vote Republican but have never considered joining the Chesterfield County GOP, now is the time.
The Chesterfield Board of Supervisors is majority Democrat and we need to have a functioning committee that works to hard to return us back to a Republican majority.
Hope to see you next month. Stay tuned for the date and location! In liberty,

| Peter,

Californians are bearing the brunt of climate change – from wildfires to droughts, we are becoming increasingly unequipped to handle our toughest challenges. If Republicans hold onto their majority and reelect Trump, it will only get worse from here.

Climate change disproportionately impacts Black and Brown communities, even right here in CA-38.

**31% of Latinos live within 30 miles of a power plant, and Latinos are 165% more likely to live in areas where particulate matter pollution is at unhealthy levels.**

_**Peter, these numbers are deeply concerning.**_

In Congress, I’m working to tackle the disproportionate impacts of climate change in our communities. We need more of us in Congress.

[_**This Earth Day, let’s recommit to investing in our planet and electing climate champions to Congress.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83530488/468681597/-1702732256?refcode=BLU_EM_SAN_2024-04-22_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODI2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzODE0OGNiMy1mMzAwLWVmMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qKKQb_Urq6ly-4zeihtoeGmk-S1L4nTbfPybBBRS1DI=)

name: Zach Shrewsbury
subject: BREAKING: Manchin 2.0
body:
The big suits are looking to keep things just the way they are.

| | | [ ](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=j5fNBxs3a3N4qD2Ew7zDqIVf6g-l4FLVqwvq1vwG43XdtoRCV0vQBXLNTs-Z52oOCGJqlPF1Rt7Y4-fBqetktflpC6OvD64DUUHtr5XVX_O2JEHJ2IzlfkLs1it2vYL6&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=042224_manchin_2_0&n=1)
---
Hi Friend, When we launched our campaign for the U.S. Senate, we understood that West Virginians, and indeed the country, deserved better than what we have in Joe Manchin. Senator Manchin just announced his endorsement of my opponent, Glenn Elliott, for the Senate. To me, that's more than just a political play. **It's a clear sign that the big suits are looking to keep things just the way they are,** making sure their pockets stay lined, while folks like us keep breaking our backs just to make ends meet. Now, the choice is crystal clear: the same old song and dance where the bigwigs keep the power, talking a good game but leaving us out in the cold when it comes to making real changes **OR a Senator whose vision includes a real living wage, universal healthcare with no co-pays and surprise bills from hospital, tuition-free public colleges and universities, universal childcare similar to the free K-12 public schools, and a foreign policy rooted in diplomacy, peace, and cooperation.** With just over a month before the primary, we know what West Virginians want and are confident in their choice, but we need your help to ensure that every voter comes to the voting booth on May 14. **[Can you chip in $15, $25, or even $50 to help our campaign succeed?](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=j5fNBxs3a3N4qD2Ew7zDqIVf6g-l4FLVqwvq1vwG43XdtoRCV0vQBXLNTs-Z52oOCGJqlPF1Rt7Y4-fBqetktflpC6OvD64DUUHtr5XVX_O2JEHJ2IzlfkLs1it2vYL6&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=042224_manchin_2_0&n=2)**
---
| [](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=j5fNBxs3a3N4qD2Ew7zDqIVf6g-l4FLVqwvq1vwG43XdtoRCV0vQBXLNTs-Z52oOCGJqlPF1Rt7Y4-fBqetktflpC6OvD64DUUHtr5XVX_O2JEHJ2IzlfkLs1it2vYL6&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=042224_manchin_2_0&n=3 "DONATE TODAY >>") [DONATE TODAY >>](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=j5fNBxs3a3N4qD2Ew7zDqIVf6g-l4FLVqwvq1vwG43XdtoRCV0vQBXLNTs-Z52oOCGJqlPF1Rt7Y4-fBqetktflpC6OvD64DUUHtr5XVX_O2JEHJ2IzlfkLs1it2vYL6&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=042224_manchin_2_0&n=3)
---
We've been shouting for a decent wage to provide for our families without running ourselves ragged. We’ve been demanding the end of environmental destruction that leaves our land and the people on the brink of death. But where's the action on that? Seems like it's always just out of reach, with folks like Elliott and Manchin holding the reins. So, here's the deal. **This endorsement? It's not just a nod from one politician to another. It's a signal, loud and clear that they're not looking to shake things up. They're fine with the status quo, where the rich get richer, and folks like us get the short end of the stick.** It is significant to understand that Glenn Elliott has been actively pursuing Joe Manchin’s endorsement, knowing that the infamous Senator has been at odds with the Senate Democrats in major ways and is one of the most unreliable senators, often joining Republicans on major policy issues:
* He has often opposed regulations that he perceives as harmful to the coal industry.
* He opposed the Women's Health Protection Act, which sought to codify abortion rights nationally.
* He voted for Justice Kavanaugh, further endangering womens’ rights and failing to protect reproductive freedoms.
* He voted to roll back bank regulations that had been put in place after the 2008 financial crisis, opening the door to irresponsible speculations in the financial sector.

**Our campaign offers a new voice to echo the halls of the Senate, speaking for the working man, the single moms, the families just trying to get by.** So, let's roll up our sleeves and get to work. This isn't just my fight; it's our fight. Together, we can bring about the change we desperately need. **[Let's show them what real, hardworking Americans can do when we stand united for a fair and just future.](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=j5fNBxs3a3N4qD2Ew7zDqIVf6g-l4FLVqwvq1vwG43XdtoRCV0vQBXLNTs-Z52oOCGJqlPF1Rt7Y4-fBqetktflpC6OvD64DUUHtr5XVX_O2JEHJ2IzlfkLs1it2vYL6&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=042224_manchin_2_0&n=4)** Zach

We’re in a maternal health crisis, particularly for Black women and babies. | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.X6XUC7u8ppFLNtMO_55SZlNseb7gEYIOhm_EWnhzEOZKmTtnV3k2h4V2x_O3H7rdW2az5rgktBwzxQ8Ml9Wgkmv85qW-UsBonL4KRa0bcNqdICU6T3NBDdNIZG7w7wEWRR-3RrjDM7P1mEbF-PcSoI31V0dUT2GNXeNT2JNJYFO_mKYA4xiY2p0saGi2oIAqFJEllnYnNHW3u8sumxApTUO6JBe-y6h3authznalzgQtDyD3Vy99BJ4KWupCilG_RVM-fDrVyKA3J9VRPLEWUZwm3AblauJ-0k6sVYsuk487nvxaGY7hv4EwmY_vkXJPzglb9Kwib4kCHjnz1Esiq8kaEtT39J1vXu-_qqHmq8o/45q/pUyIgriyT8C9_-n0X9yCwQ/h0/h001.lJGZYmEYpHVb8ExkRmx1mP0OtN2sh_-uKsDgLK6nthc)

Friend, We’re in a maternal health crisis: the United States maternal mortality rate is rising, and Black women are 3 to 4 times more likely to die from pregnancy-related causes than white women. Black women have been systematically neglected and mistreated in our healthcare system, and they’re also more likely to live with health conditions from air and water pollution. I’ve been discussing these urgent challenges with colleagues and advocates during the past week’s Black Maternal Health Week. **As part of advocating to dismantle the systematic racism in our healthcare system, I’m urging Congress to pass the**** _Black Maternal Health Momnibus Act_****.** This legislative package includes 13 bills that would:
* Extend WIC eligibility during postpartum and breastfeeding periods to provide crucial nutrition for parents and babies
* Support anti-bias trainings for employees in maternity care settings and establish Respectful Maternity Care Compliance Programs to address racism and promote accountability
* Expand access to high-quality maternal mental health care and substance use services
* Increase the number of nurses, midwives, physician assistants, doulas, and other perinatal health workers who moms can trust throughout their pregnancies, labor and delivery, and the postpartum period
* Improve maternal healthcare and support for incarcerated moms, including ending the horrific process of shackling people as they give birth
* Invest in community-based initiatives to reduce levels of and exposure to pollution and climate change-related risks
* Fund community-based organizations and Tribal organizations working on maternal health

clean_body: We’re in a maternal health crisis, particularly for Black women and babies. | | | Friend, We’re in a maternal health crisis: the United States maternal mortality rate is rising, and Black women are 3 to 4 times more likely to die from pregnancy-related causes than white women. Black women have been systematically neglected and mistreated in our healthcare system, and they’re also more likely to live with health conditions from air and water pollution. I’ve been discussing these urgent challenges with colleagues and advocates during the past week’s Black Maternal Health Week. As part of advocating to dismantle the systematic racism in our healthcare system, I’m urging Congress to pass the Black Maternal Health Momnibus Act. This legislative package includes 13 bills that would: Extend WIC eligibility during postpartum and breastfeeding periods to provide crucial nutrition for parents and babies Support anti-bias trainings for employees in maternity care settings and establish Respectful Maternity Care Compliance Programs to address racism and promote accountability Expand access to high-quality maternal mental health care and substance use services Increase the number of nurses, midwives, physician assistants, doulas, and other perinatal health workers who moms can trust throughout their pregnancies, labor and delivery, and the postpartum period Improve maternal healthcare and support for incarcerated moms, including ending the horrific process of shackling people as they give birth Invest in community-based initiatives to reduce levels of and exposure to pollution and climate change-related risks Fund community-based organizations and Tribal organizations working on maternal health Most pregnancy-related deaths are preventable, and it’s urgent that we implement these solutions to save lives now. | In Michigan, lawmakers have also introduced the “MI Momnibus” bill package to improve healthcare quality, access, and outcomes for Black women and birthing people in our state. Across the country, we will continue the push to eradicate racial disparities in maternal and infant health, and to dismantle systemic racism in all our institutions. Friend,
Happy Earth Day!
It’s a beautiful day to enjoy the incredible outdoor spaces in Colorado — and to continue our work to protect public lands.
From working to designate Camp Hale as a national monument to establishing Camp Amache as our newest national park, Michael is committed to protecting treasured landscapes for the next generation. The Camp Hale monument alone protects more than 50,000 acres of public lands for future generations to enjoy.
Michael continues his fight to pass the CORE Act, a bill that would protect almost 400,000 additional acres and across Colorado.
In writing this bill, Michael brought together a coalition of public officials, conservationists, sportsmen, wildlife advocates, and more. The result is a bill that will create new areas for outdoor recreation, protect stunning landscapes, and strengthen our economy — a win-win for everyone.

The science is clear: Climate change is leading to more intense storms and flooding, dangerously high temperatures, droughts, rising sea levels, and damage to ecosystems and wildlife. That’s why, during my time in office, we prioritized moving toward a clean energy economy that provides good-paying jobs while protecting our environment. To that end, can you help with a contribution to the effort? We'll immediately put it to good use. Here is the link if you can help. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lvf_feb_2024]

Zoe

> During my interview with _TIME_ , we discussed how the escalating climate crisis is deeply personal to me. I’d seen firsthand what it was doing to California at the height of the wildfire season. I’d heard the stories of fossil fuel companies poisoning entire communities — many of them Indigenous or communities of color — and _all of that_ , coupled with my own battle with cancer, only intensified my resolve.
> We are the first generation to feel the climate crisis in full force and the last that can prevent its catastrophic outcomes. At a young 86, I am compelled more than ever to lead by example and prove that _no one_ is too old or too young to make a difference.
> **The first step out of despair is simply showing up — something we must all do.**

Fellow American,

Let me be frank. ****_Like the rest of us, you've probably noticed your wallet is feeling awfully light these days._** ** Let’s look at some quick facts about why this may be:

* We’re competing with California for the **[highest gas prices](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=90173473fccc4197a10bed9d58997bcb&_e=ejVSzh92YLkFcJM_NQs0u_UGqKv5hQw3Oxm5t2k0ZS0aHRxD0GHYaEO7CRagHekiXcJD2efpQqs7MnS5BjSkvsyZp-q2ofyKLYCUhR-KUHAQhWhFXEhkYn8ZQ01eTggv49Q5c41VYWgMDQ4fBemENYyAnGVJ3aVJTqvq4o6FrANj0wTxT6StsOrvQDBdfzY1k-MT_qtEvgk_jgImEWHRYojyEafuZBtygCNXYkCMMMdmG_ZAdlLJHJjOp1LwC1GuouC4NwGLuK85XUaZ-Z01ePuNrWJ9oayupFSiJOkUKJxM3cxQ-IqV4mVRgkJzB467Mc7y-fEvzYqvYc-qUPzcoBQJaRLuuvgyKRV60F9qlMrczQ6TwpQUajXFAcIf7KCGOgrlydo5C0Ax_Qy9X5XN18xOh50_uC8s3FoDvhWOlOE%3D)** in the country
* Our property tax rates are **[rising exponentially](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=90173473fccc4197a10bed9d58997bcb&_e=ejVSzh92YLkFcJM_NQs0u_UGqKv5hQw3Oxm5t2k0ZS0aHRxD0GHYaEO7CRagHekiXcJD2efpQqs7MnS5BjSkvsyZp-q2ofyKLYCUhR-KUHAQhWhFXEhkYn8ZQ01eTggv49Q5c41VYWgMDQ4fBemENYyAnGVJ3aVJTqvq4o6FrANj0wTxT6StsOrvQDBdfzY1k-MT_qtEvgk_jgImEWHRYojyEafuZBtygCNXYkCMMMdmG_ZAdlLJHJjOp1LwC1GuouC4NwGLuK85XUaZ-Z01eEx2CuV_GEy3wKO0JDWhAYcZ7oKkt8B28awZ5Im8LhnwNaptmiccqazRryFTtGr3VT16zz4EmQAObahc8_l_m3xL1UnfuLeUHltVa_ccoIm_ChXN_xqrCO8iVqm0dIz0-xPVBuxRr4691eJV3ZOuKmk%3D)** and pricing people out
* **[Bidenflation](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=90173473fccc4197a10bed9d58997bcb&_e=ejVSzh92YLkFcJM_NQs0u_UGqKv5hQw3Oxm5t2k0ZS0aHRxD0GHYaEO7CRagHekiXcJD2efpQqs7MnS5BjSkvsyZp-q2ofyKLYCUhR-KUHAQhWhFXEhkYn8ZQ01eTggv49Q5c41VYWgMDQ4fBemENYyAnGVJ3aVJTqvq4o6FrANj0wTxT6StsOrvQDBdfzY1k-MT_qtEvgk_jgImEWHRYojyEafuZBtygCNXYkCMMMdmG_ZAdlLJHJjOp1LwC1GuouC4NwGLuK85XUaZ-Z01eI1Jhl2fMH-6bk9O0Vz_cci_xKpnA64bjPGBxywEz0czGpq3khVlzTbEzRxTIX1P2bzf55FUPmO-1pOSQdNa51ELBGjG7p2vSlhHFzhN6PdOQbg-BjcDAY904kT-i3uEnlAKvhZnXo0AoRyULVSkpjo%3D)** has ripped money out of our pockets
* Leftist leaders in Olympia **[refuse to stimulate](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=90173473fccc4197a10bed9d58997bcb&_e=ejVSzh92YLkFcJM_NQs0u_UGqKv5hQw3Oxm5t2k0ZS0aHRxD0GHYaEO7CRagHekiXcJD2efpQqs7MnS5BjSkvsyZp-q2ofyKLYCUhR-KUHAQhWhFXEhkYn8ZQ01eTggv49Q5c41VYWgMDQ4fBemENYyAnGVJ3aVJTqvq4o6FrANj0wTxT6StsOrvQDBdfzY1k-MT_qtEvgk_jgImEWHRYojyEafuZBtygCNXYkCMMMdmG_ZAdlLJHJjOp1LwC1GuouC4NwGLuK85XUaZ-Z01eOTy8PQJMYRi7_41v3U00Y6vMcWi35231k_1009hyvi4dTs41qPjt_oP7WgAy6eDXzQ1OEENu79GD6wswbKGiBd17xVgGke_wwQ1uel0tG-DSDgNNsIizLGjxVMoXb-cUmQu65I1QF9J3hWNgn1sVao%3D)** our economy by lowering taxes
* Loose liberal policies on crime are causing our businesses to **[close their doors.](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=90173473fccc4197a10bed9d58997bcb&_e=ejVSzh92YLkFcJM_NQs0u_UGqKv5hQw3Oxm5t2k0ZS0aHRxD0GHYaEO7CRagHekiXcJD2efpQqs7MnS5BjSkvsyZp-q2ofyKLYCUhR-KUHAQhWhFXEhkYn8ZQ01eTggv49Q5c41VYWgMDQ4fBemENYyAnGVJ3aVJTqvq4o6FrANj0wTxT6StsOrvQDBdfzY1k-MT_qtEvgk_jgImEWHRYojyEafuZBtygCNXYkCMMMdmG_ZAdlLJHJjOp1LwC1GuouC4NwGLuK85XUaZ-Z01ePB3zR75CYb3drYSI-Y6uhOGAK2EDXg_M8y_VUTWhwvUivtabshodKaRqc9Fnb6JO4S4e-dQb7fuY1EUA__rFe5RPatFD-ow3YQJGK9P5aBEMeccflSNn-yExnAqdxQh6Z1Zg52Uy2jSYpmP7Bg4sNQ%3D)**

Simply put, these nonsensical Democrat policies are resulting in your bank account looking mighty empty. It’s pretty easy for a corrupt government to take power away from the people and keep them financially unstable.

**[I’m here to fix that. Under my leadership, we’ll see the economy flourish.](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=90173473fccc4197a10bed9d58997bcb&_e=ejVSzh92YLkFcJM_NQs0u_UGqKv5hQw3Oxm5t2k0ZS0aHRxD0GHYaEO7CRagHekiXcJD2efpQqs7MnS5BjSkvsyZp-q2ofyKLYCUhR-KUHAQhWhFXEhkYn8ZQ01eTggv49Q5c41VYWgMDQ4fBemENYyAnGVJ3aVJTqvq4o6FrANj0wTxT6StsOrvQDBdfzY1k-MT_qtEvgk_jgImEWHRYojyEafuZBtygCNXYkCMMMdmG_ZAdlLJHJjOp1LwC1GuouC4NwGLuK85XUaZ-Z01eK3SFmigZDZUWYX6N0xW5KvyreqwYjJ_ouTUKsPUhIJC1rCyjj9NSE1UX-ySFzVea98CCo9JpVk9o3S163sSN4EvV_V8HWx3iw_ycBC6ZwUd0HjpQUZ-lnUFjoCg7hHqlVRsWw3I1-G1qyvANEDExyc%3D)**
I will implement policies to lower your taxes, reduce government regulation, and assist in the growth of small businesses in our area. This will foster job creation, business investment, and a higher cash flow to benefit both businesses and consumers like you. _**The solution is simple, really, but the Left can’t seem to wrap their heads around it.**_

**[Take some bold steps today.](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=90173473fccc4197a10bed9d58997bcb&_e=ejVSzh92YLkFcJM_NQs0u_UGqKv5hQw3Oxm5t2k0ZS0aHRxD0GHYaEO7CRagHekiXcJD2efpQqs7MnS5BjSkvsyZp-q2ofyKLYCUhR-KUHAQhWhFXEhkYn8ZQ01eTggv49Q5c41VYWgMDQ4fBemENYyAnGVJ3aVJTqvq4o6FrANj0wTxT6StsOrvQDBdfzY1k-MT_qtEvgk_jgImEWHRYojyEafuZBtygCNXYkCMMMdmG_ZAdlLJHJjOp1LwC1GuouC4NwGLuK85XUaZ-Z01eDdoSmKm7nqcXpTYV-FCV0qaDCFEnggbBSnSD4lYnwtfDyQgGW-8EbY967wG3X3DHrkBnFZl9xfeyAor7XMUzatVTqXS6iC7Me3w3VFlXNan5u8pWbcqT743CwhHem1W6gjZKgC3w5bV4MNU7rRmXPY%3D)** Invest in your future and support the Reichert Campaign to restore the once-thriving Washington. Don’t waste time; policy needs to be enacted to save our future as soon as possible.

Thanks as always,

Dave Reichert

It's Rick Scott. I was proudly the 45th Governor of Florida and now serve as a United States Senator for the Sunshine State.

I put YOU first. _**NOT**_ Washington insider deals.

What a relief to finally see an example of bipartisan action in the U.S. House of Representatives!| | | [](http://links.johnkasich.com/u/click?_t=6a3b28686d0a4d77958e12349305a4fe&_m=e3f02353c9924223b3187e06d6b0c234&_e=mNlsnd5bMDs82pNlbS7ivArKz9oCCg24C5DKg8l_RnVZ0UWaqHt4V7jb96NRNuqpHiBJI2a1wp11k3G9C-Kj8SDRIvQ6w7-kDrr38c5hKDo0YRdclVNqzQB0Q2pC0cFy8KtfDr_BhZSzZT82WWw6734_r_cEoIKQykiobsnc7RkZMrQfqBYLm62zNkZ_zXf2fvw-1aNX7RfEGHgkXfs8cA%3D%3D)
---
Peter, What a relief to finally see an example of bipartisan action in the U.S. House of Representatives!

In case you missed the news this past weekend, Republican Speaker Mike Johnson ignored the threats of the obstructionist members of his party and brought legislation to the floor to send critical funds to our allies in Ukraine, Israel and Taiwan.

All three bills passed with strong bipartisan majorities. This is the kind of thing the United States, as the preeminent world leader, must do to ensure stability and survival of western values.

Despite the objections of those members of Congress who naively think that an isolationist approach to foreign policy will lead to anything other than a diminished America and emboldened enemies, with this vote, America is strengthening our alliances and improving our own national and economic security.

While this was an important milestone, the reality is that finding bipartisan agreement on big issues is the kind of thing America should be doing every day...not something that is so rare that we find ourselves in amazed disbelief when it actually happens.

But maybe, just maybe, this is what members of Congress needed to see in order to believe in the power of cooperation once again. At least, that's my hope. Time will tell if this is the start of something positive or if it was just a blip in a sad, continued phase of dysfunction.

Peter - you know me pretty well by this point. I try to focus on the positive in situations and I remain hopeful that this will help more elected leaders find the courage to do what's right for the American people.
---
I'm so appreciative for your ongoing support. Thank you! -John
---

clean_body: Judicial Watch announced recently it received 5 pages of records from the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) in a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) request that show an April 2020 email exchange with several officials in the bureau’s Newark Field Office referring to Dr. Anthony Fauci’s National Institute of Allergies and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) grant to the Wuhan Institute of Virology (WIV) in China as including “gain-of-function research” which “would leave no signature of purposeful human manipulation.” | | | | | | Because no one is above the law! | Apr 22, 2024 ---|---|--- Today's Top Stories | | | | | Judicial Watch announced recently it received 5 pages of records from the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) in a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) request that show an April 2020 email exchange with several officials in the bureau’s Newark Field Office referring to Dr. Anthony Fauci’s National Institute of Allergies and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) grant to the Wuhan Institute of Virology (WIV) in China as including “gain-of-function research” which “would leave no signature of purposeful human manipulation.” ---|--- | | | | | The Biden administration’s failure to secure the Mexican border forced Texas officials to establish a security initiative that has endured heavy criticism from Democrats and the media despite its success in apprehending hundreds of thousands of illegal immigrants—including thousands of criminals—and seizing millions of lethal doses of fentanyl. It is known as Operation Lone Star, and it was launched by Governor Greg Abbott in March 2021 as the illegal immigration crisis gripped his border state. Under the program, the Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS) and the Texas National Guard pick up the slack for the federal government, which is charged with protecting the famously porous southern border but has failed miserably to do so. Operation Lone Star works to stop the smuggling of drugs, weapons and people into Texas, and interdict transnational criminal activity between ports of entry. ---|--- | | | | | Judicial Watch filed the lawsuit after ODNI failed to comply with a February 21, 2024, FOIA request for damage assessments and equity reviews performed by the Office of the Director of National Intelligence related to the materials improperly removed by Biden. ---|--- | | | | | Fraud and corruption are so rampant in the U.S. government’s mammoth pandemic relief program that the Justice Department created a special COVID-19 Fraud Enforcement Task Force (CFETF) to crack down on scams and recover some of the stolen funds. A few days ago, it published an update on its work and American taxpayers should be furious. ---|--- | | | The Sun Sentinel In a letter to Whitehouse, Patronis said he found the Democratic senator’s requests in November and March for information about Citizens Property Insurance Corp. “especially alarming” in light of an ethics complaint by conservative foundation Judicial Watch asserting that Whitehouse voted for environmental projects that financially benefitted his wife’s consulting business. Judicial Watch routinely targets Democrats and members of the Biden Administration with lawsuits and Freedom of Information Act requests, and then posts stories about the requests on its website. They need to be pardoned. They need to have their sentences commuted.” The Independent Tom Fitton, the president of the conservative organisation Judicial Watch, says Mr Trump is right to criticise the legal system, including judges, arguing that many of his complaints are “well-founded”. “It’s his absolute right as a citizen to raise these issues, and certainly as a criminal defendant and presidential candidate there are even heightened First Amendment protections for what he has said,” he tells The Independent. “Unfortunately, we have too many judges acting politically as opposed to following and applying the law in an unbiased manner. | CLIPS | | | | | | Keep our investigators on the job uncovering the truth: | | | | | ---|---|--- Judicial Watch, Inc. 425 3rd St Sw Ste 800, Washington, DC 20024 202.646.5172 (C)2017-2024, All Rights Reserved |

Hello, in just a minute I’ll ask you to split a contribution between my campaign and Debbie Mucarsel-Powell's ahead of our critical weekly deadline, but first I hope you’ll give me a moment to explain why it’s so important to give—especially today.
I grew up on my family’s farm, and Sharla and I still work that land today. In my opinion, being a farmer makes me a better senator. My background is a big part of the reason I remain grounded and focused on defending our Montana way of life. Because with all the chaos in Washington (especially now), you need somebody who will roll up their sleeves and get to work.
Last time I ran, nearly $70 million was spent on the Montana Senate race. This time around, we’ve already passed that number: **A****n eye-popping $120 million has been spent or reserved in advertising alone.** It’ll take a lot of support from this team to raise what we’ll need to protect this seat.
And if you know me, I’m not the kind of person who likes to ask for money. But I bet Mitch McConnell would be _furious_ if we showed him that a whole lot of grassroots power is stronger than his wealthy donors and super PACs will ever be.
Let’s be clear: **This election isn’t a sure thing.** Experts say this race is a toss-up and rank Montana as one of the seats most likely to flip. That’s why it’s SO important you make a contribution today—everything is on the line.
Everyone—including Mitch McConnell—is watching what we raise to judge the strength of this team. **I don’t expect you to chip in every time I ask, but I need you on my side now more than ever to show our opponents we’re ready to fight back and win.**
[**Will you split a contribution between my campaign and Debbie's today? body:
This is a moment of great consequence. Congress just had our first official vote where we can weigh in on the direction of the war in Gaza.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20240422-3784-footer&t=1&akid=3784%2E420207%2E0kd6Ui)
Peter — this is a moment of great consequence. Congress just had our first official vote where we can weigh in on the direction of the war in Gaza.
**I am proud to be one of the 37 Democrats to vote against supplying more offensive military aid that could result in more killings of civilians in Gaza.**
Most Americans**do not** want our government to write a blank check to further Netanyahu’s war in Gaza. The United States needs to help Israel find a path to win the peace.
That is what our vote was about. Voting to continue supplying offensive military aid only makes Congress complicit in this tragedy.
My vote against H.R. 8034 was a vote against supplying more offensive weapons that could result in more killings of civilians in Rafah and elsewhere. The dozens of Democrats who voted with me all believe strongly in Israel’s right to self-defense and have joined colleagues previously in affirming our shared commitment. We are committed to a sovereign, safe, and secure future for both Israelis and Palestinians.
**To protect that future, we believe the United States must help achieve a ceasefire that allows hostages to be freed, humanitarian aid to be delivered, and peace talks to begin.**
Netanyahu appears willing to sacrifice the hostages while inflicting extraordinary suffering on the people of Gaza. He is willing to expand this conflict to preserve his power at the expense of Israel’s safety.
In recent weeks, reports have indicated that Netanyahu is moving closer to a full-scale invasion of the southern Gaza town of Rafah, where more than a million Palestinians have taken shelter.
When faced with the question of whether to provide offensive aid to further this conflict, I believe there is a moral imperative to find another path.
[**If you stand with me, please consider supporting this campaign with a contribution of any amount.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240422.196o4d&refcode=em20240422-3784&t=2&akid=3784%2E420207%2E0kd6Ui)

In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

Democrat Eric Swalwell represents California's 14th Congressional District.
https://ericswalwell.com/ [https://ericswalwell.com/]
Friend,

There's an often-overlooked aspect of the Ukraine aid debate. I shared my insights into how supporting Ukraine’s war efforts helps Americans back home with MSNBC. You can read my full op-ed here. [https://www.msnbc.com/opinion/msnbc-opinion/ukraine-war-aid-house-vote-swalwell-rcna148396]

READ MORE » [https://www.msnbc.com/opinion/msnbc-opinion/ukraine-war-aid-house-vote-swalwell-rcna148396]

It's easy to hear the phrase "foreign aid" and think about dollars flying overseas. But here's the twist: a significant portion of the aid we send to Ukraine is actually spent right here in the USA.

Consider this: 57% of the emergency aid previously approved for Ukraine bolstered American jobs — from manufacturing advanced weapons systems to resupplying our own military stockpiles. Over $5.5 billion of that was spent in states like Arizona, Pennsylvania, and Texas alone. That's not just aid; that's an investment in our economy and our security.

Remember, supporting Ukraine isn't just about helping them — it's about making strategic investments that protect our future. It's about jobs, it's about security, and it's about keeping America strong in a world where threats loom large. Your support matters in shaping global stability.

READ MORE » [https://www.msnbc.com/opinion/msnbc-opinion/ukraine-war-aid-house-vote-swalwell-rcna148396]

This isn't just about dollars; it's common sense. The kind that tells us that investing in global stability can help save American lives and American jobs. Don't let this crucial perspective get drowned out by the noise. Check out the details, and let's spread the word together.

Thanks for staying informed and engaged,

Eric Swalwell
